jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Laser-Induced Graphene (LIG) Sensors for Composite Materials
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We have a new vacancy for a 3-year PhD position at ASEMlab, NTNU Gjøvik, funded by Horizon Europe projects. The PhD candidate will work with NTNU's laser-induced graphene (LIG) sensing line developing a LIG sensor system for in-situ process monitoring of fibre reinforced composite systems, and maturing it from lab-scale prototypes to integration in demonstrators. The LIG system will be developed and benchmarked alongside complementary sensing technologies. This is a doctorate at the intersection of functional 2D materials, printed electronics, industrial composites manufacturing and structural health monitoring.

The position is hosted by ASEMlab – the Laboratory of Advanced and Sustainable Engineering Materials (www.asemlab.no) at the Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, NTNU – Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Gjøvik campus. ASEMlab performs research on polymers and composite materials across their full life cycle: advanced manufacturing, structural health monitoring and sensing, non-destructive evaluation, durability and ageing, recycling and circularity, and sustainability assessment. The laboratory operates extensive infrastructure including manufacturing, sensor development, laser systems, thermal and physico-chemical analysis (DMA, TGA, FTIR, dielectric spectroscopy), mechanical and thermomechanical fatigue testing, accelerated ageing facilities, micro-CT, CMM, ultrasound imaging, etc.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • design and fabricate laser-induced graphene sensors and sensor arrays (temperature, strain, pressure) using ASEMlab's laser-processing infrastructure
  • characterise and calibrate the sensors electromechanically, structurally, thermally, morphologically, etc., using advanced analytical techniques, and benchmark them against complementary sensing technologies (e.g. fibre optics)
  • develop the LIG sensor system for process monitoring and structural health monitoring
  • implement the data-acquisition chain and data-import protocols as well as analyze sensor data for different needs 
  • Work closely with interdisciplinary teams of internal and external researchers specializing in sensor technologies, materials science, data analytics, etc.
  • analyze data and publish results in leading international journals and present at conferences, contribute to project deliverables, training workshops and dissemination activities

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (link), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in materials science/engineering, electronics/mechatronics, applied physics, nanotechnology, mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • demonstrated hands-on experience working in a research laboratory environment, including the safe handling of chemicals and operation of scientific instrumentation
  • strong foundational understanding of solid-state physics/chemistry and materials characterization techniques (such as Raman spectroscopy, SEM, or XRD)
  • hands-on experimental skills within sensors or functional/printed materials
  • very good written and oral English skills (documented per NTNU requirements for non-native speakers)
  • proven ability to work independently, manage a research project timeline, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • experience in the design, fabrication, or characterization of electromechanical sensors, printed/flexible sensors, or graphene/2D and carbon-based functional materials 
  • hands-on experience with laser synthesis, laser micromachining, or optical systems, including CO₂ or UV laser platforms commonly used for LIG fabrication
  • experience with electronics prototyping, instrumentation and data acquisition tools (Python, LabVIEW), electrical characterization hardware (e.g., source meters, potentiostats, impedance analyzers) and basic signal processing, while interest in machine-learning-based process control is a plus
  • knowledge of fibre-reinforced polymer composites and their manufacturing processes
  • experience with electrical/electromechanical characterisation techniques (e.g. impedance spectroscopy, DIC-coupled strain sensing)
  • willingness to travel for test and demonstration campaigns for project needs in Europe 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • proactive, self-driven, structured and rigorous in experimental work
  • collaborative and team-oriented mindset suited to a university lab and a large industrial consortium with firm deadlines
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • curiosity and ambition to publish at a high international level

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in an international, EU-funded project consortium
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Science Doctoral Programme - PhD - Faculty of Engineering Science - NTNU within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who, by assessment of the application and attachments, are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.

Please note that the candidate holding the announced position is expected to work with critical infrastructure and areas subject to controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology. Candidates with the potential of not fulfilling the requirements for security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the Act Relating to National Security, the Export Control Act and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered for the position.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates/diplomas (BSc and MSc) with grade transcripts; diplomas in other languages must be accompanied by certified English translations
  • a motivation letter (max 2 pages) describing your suitability for and interest in the position
  • MSc thesis (or a draft if not yet completed) and any publications or other relevant research output
  • documentation of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS/TOEFL) where applicable
  • names and contact details of at least two referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Sotirios Grammatikos, Director of ASEMlab, Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, NTNU Gjøvik. E-mail: sotirios.grammatikos@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Kristine Rognlid Hagaseth kristine.r.hagaseth@ntnu.no 

Application deadline: 11.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

Delo poteka v urejenem in prijetnem okolju, kjer sta kakovostna storitev in oseben odnos do gosta na prvem mestu. Iščemo osebo, ki ji delo z ljudmi predstavlja zadovoljstvo, zna prisluhniti gostom ter svoje delo opravlja odgovorno in profesionalno. Od vas pričakujemo: - prijazen, profesionalen in spoštljiv odnos do gostov, - komunikativnost in veselje do dela z ljudmi,  - odgovornost, zanesljivost in samostojnost pri delu, - urejenost in pozitiven odnos do dela, - predhodne izkušnje na področju strežbe so dobrodošle, niso pa pogoj.  Kaj vam ponujamo: - zaposlitev za polni delovni čas, 40 ur tedensko, - delo v edinstvenem okolju Butičnega hotela v Bohinju, - prijetno in urejeno delovno okolje, - delo v manjši, povezani in profesionalni ekipi, - možnost pridobivanja novih znanj in izkušenj na področju hotelirstva in gostinstva, - možnost dolgoročnega sodelovanja.  Če ste gostoljubna, odgovorna in pozitivna oseba, ki si želi dela, pri katerem lahko s svojim odnosom neposredno vpliva na zadovoljstvo gostov, vas vabimo, da se nam pridružite. jobs.title: Vil du bli en viktig del av hverdagen min?
jobs.employer: MEDVIND ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Jeg er en gutt på 14 år som ser etter en trygg, positiv og engasjert BPA-assistent som kan bli en del av teamet mitt. Rollen som BPA-assistent er variert, og ingen dager er helt like. Jeg trenger deg som kan være en trygg støtte i hverdagen og bidra til at dagene mine blir gode og meningsfulle. Hvem er du? Jeg ser etter deg som trives sammen med ungdom og er god på å danne relasjoner. Du er trygg, tålmodig og omsorgsfull, og du må kunne by på deg selv. Det er viktig for meg at du er pålitelig, omtenksom og har et ønske om å bidra til at både små og store øyeblikk i hverdagen blir gode. Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha erfaring som BPA-assistent fra før. Det viktigste er at du er en person som ønsker å bli kjent med meg og som kan være en trygg og positiv støtte i hverdagen min.   Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Være med på aktiviteter hjemme og ute
  • Bistå med personlig hygiene og daglige rutiner
  • Være en støttespiller i sosiale sammenhenger
  • Gi trygghet og struktur i hverdagen
Du må ha førerkort klasse B, siden assistentene mine henter meg på skolen ved skoleslutt. Jeg har min egen bil. Du må også ha plettfri vandel. Arbeidstid Stillingen er deltid/tilkalling, med gode muligheter for jobb både i hverdager og i ferier. Arbeidstid avtales nærmere med familien. Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull jobb der du virkelig gjør en forskjell
  • God opplæring og støtte
  • Et inkluderende og hyggelig arbeidsmiljø
  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser
For rette kandidat er det klart for oppstart og opplæring snarest. Jeg og foreldrene mine vil vurdere søknader fortløpende, så ikke nøl med å sende inn din. Nå vet du litt om meg, og jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg – kanskje blir du en del av teamet mitt!  
Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Norge søker en nasjonal ekspert til Hybridsenteret i Helsingfors
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Hybridsenteret utfører policyarbeid som støtter medlemslandene i å forstå og håndtere utfordringene som hybride trusler skaper. Arbeidet innebærer blant annet å utarbeide selvstendige analyser, bestille og administrere analytiske prosjekter blant annet fra akademia, og presentere Hybridsenterets arbeid på konferanser og webinarer.

Den norske stillingen vil være særlig rettet mot hybride trusler i nordområdene og vil spille en viktig rolle i forbindelse med Hybridsenterets arbeid på dette feltet.

Sikkerhetspolitisk avdeling i Utenriksdepartementet vil ha arbeidsgiveransvaret og koordinere den faglige oppfølgingen av den nasjonale eksperten.


Ansvarsområder og oppgaver

Som sekondert nasjonal ekspert til Hybridsenteret vil du ha følgende ansvar og oppgaver:

  • Utarbeide analyser og kunnskapsgrunnlag om hybride trusler i Arktis
  • Videreutvikle kompetansen på hybride trusler i Arktis i samarbeid med leder, basert på spesifiserte behov for nøkkelkompetanse og utviklingen i regionen
  • Presentere forskning i regi av Hybridsenteret på internasjonale konferanser, webinarer og policybrifinger
  • Bygge nettverk med representanter for medlemslandene, akademiske fagmiljøer og andre relevante aktører

Kvalifikasjoner

For å være kvalifisert må du

  • ha utdanning på minimum mastergradsnivå innen internasjonale relasjoner, statsvitenskap, økonomi, etterretning, studieretninger med fokus på nordområdene eller annet relevant område
  • ha minimum tre års arbeidserfaring fra relevante fagområder
  • ha meget gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsevner på engelsk
  • være norsk statsborger
  • kunne sikkerhetsklareres for NATO SECRET

Det er ønskelig at du har

  • bakgrunn fra sikkerhetspolitiske spørsmål, inkludert hybride trusler
  • Internasjonal arbeidserfaring

Vi tilbyr

I denne stillingen vil du få muligheten til å

  • bidra i arbeidet med aktuelle sikkerhetspolitiske utfordringer i Arktis
  • bli en del av et ledende internasjonalt fagmiljø på hybride trusler
  • utvikle faglige og personlige nettverk
  • få verdifull arbeidserfaring fra en internasjonal organisasjon

Stillingen er en midlertidig ansettelse i inntil tre år på vilkår som følger retningslinjene for nasjonale eksperter til EU, etter avtale med Utenriksdepartementet.


Om deg

For å lykkes i stillingen er det viktig at du

  • arbeider selvstendig og strukturert
  • bygger sterke relasjoner og nettverk på tvers av fagmiljøer og landegrenser
  • er god på formidling av komplekse problemstillinger
  • har gode samarbeidsevner og er fleksibel
  • har høy personlig integritet og høy etisk standard

Vi vil legge vekt på personlig egnethet.


Behandling av personopplysninger ved søknader til Hybridsenteret

Når du søker på sekonderingen til Hybridsenteret gjennom Norec, må vi sende opplysninger om deg videre til de rekrutterende departementene (Forsvarsdepartementet, Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet og Utenriksdepartementet) og til HR-representanter ved Hybridsenteret. Søknaden, CV-en og vedleggene må derfor være på engelsk.

Ved å søke på stillingene samtykker du til at vi kan dele personopplysningene dine, inkludert CV og vitnemål, med disse partene i rekrutteringsprosessen. Filene blir kryptert og passordbeskyttet før de sendes fra Norec, for å ivareta sikkerheten til personopplysningene dine.

Har du spørsmål til hvordan vi behandler personopplysningene dine, kan du kontakte oss på fn_stillinger@norec.no
 

Du kan be om å bli unntatt fra den offentlige søkerlisten. I så fall må du begrunne ønsket. Vi kontakter deg dersom ønsket ditt ikke blir innvilget.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hybridsenteret i Helsingfors er en autonom, nettverksbasert internasjonal organisasjon som arbeider for å styrke sikkerheten i medlemslandene ved å motvirke hybride trusler. Senteret ble etablert i 2017 og er åpent for alle medlemsland i EU og NATO. I dag har senteret 35 medlemsland. 

Hybridsenteret legger til rette for og binder sammen arbeidet i medlemslandene samt i EU og NATO, og legger til rette for samarbeid om hybride trusler blant annet gjennom felles øvelser. Disse inkluderer scenarioer der hybride trusler benyttes under terskelen for væpnet konflikt, og som ledd i krigføring. 

I tillegg til å tilby ekspertise, opplæring og nettverk, utvikler Hybridsenteret strategier og bidrar med implementering av disse. Senteret støtter også nettverk som går på tvers av stater og sektorer i medlemslandene.

Norge har vært medlem av Hybridsenteret siden høsten 2017. 

Mer informasjon finnes på Hybridsenterets hjemmesider.

Medlemsstatene kan sekondere nasjonale eksperter til senteret. Utenriksdepartementet, Forsvarsdepartementet og Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet har besluttet å etablere en norsk stilling ved senteret fra januar 2027. Stillingen har en varighet på inntil tre år. Arbeidsstedet er i Hybridsenterets moderne kontorlokaler i sentrum av Helsingfors. Senteret tilbyr et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og har et internt opplæringsprogram for alle ansatte.

jobs.title: Researcher in Food Control Literature Review
jobs.description:
Department of Animal Biosciences

We are looking for a researcher for a fixed-term position to conduct a scientific literature review on the effects of official food control.

About the position

We are looking for a motivated, thorough and responsible person to join our team. You will work independently on a project, with ongoing support and collaboration from the rest of the team.

A key part of the role will be to conduct a systematic literature review on the effects of official food control. The review will examine how food control influences the behaviour of food businesses and their compliance with food legislation. It will also assess which control methods and approaches have the strongest evidence of improving food safety, compliance, and the accuracy of information provided to consumers, such as food labelling.

Your main tasks will include searching for scientific literature, selecting relevant studies based on the project’s research questions, assessing the quality of the studies, and compiling and analysing the results. You will also identify gaps in current knowledge and areas where further research is needed. The role may also involve conducting interviews with relevant stakeholders, mainly in the Nordic countries.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with a PhD or other documented experience of conducting literature reviews and/or evidence reviews. Previous experience of food control, or other types of regulatory control or inspection, would be an advantage. You will be part of a supportive team while working independently and taking responsibility for this specific task. The applicant must have very good ability to read and write in English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

About us

The Department of Animal Biosciences is part of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science and is responsible for education and research in several basic and applied areas. These areas include anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, pharmacology, toxicology, genetics, breeding, immunology, bacteriology, virology, parasitology, epizootology, comparative medicine, food safety, bioinformatics and One Health. Our research covers everything from production animals to sports and pet animals, laboratory animals and wild animals. The department's researchers work on the entire scale from molecular mechanisms and microbiology to the structure, function and behaviour of animals, and how these are affected by breeding, physical activity, care, production, stress, environmental factors and diseases.

For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/Animal-Biosciences/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. jobs.title: Payroll Controller, Norway
jobs.description:
Company Description

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description

We are now looking for a Payroll Controller to join our finance team in Radisson Hotel Group!

As our Payroll Controller, Norway, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely and compliant payroll across our Norwegian entities. Working closely with HR, Operations, Accounting, HR Tech/IT and our external payroll provider, you will bring strong Norwegian payroll expertise, robust controls and a continuous-improvement mindset to the end-to-end payroll process.

This is a role where your expertise will make a real difference. You will act as the key point of contact for Norwegian payroll, ensuring quality and compliance while identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce risk and improve the employee experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the monthly pre- and post-payroll control process, reconciling variances and driving corrective actions with external payroll provider.
  • Ensure accurate calculation and processing of salaries, overtime, allowances, holiday pay, leave balances and statutory deductions.
  • Calculate HR provisions and accruals and manage monthly payroll allocations.
  • Validate employee master data, employee lists and cost-allocation structures.
  • Ensure full compliance with Norwegian payroll legislation and applicable collective agreements.
  • Oversee key Norwegian payroll processes, including NAV sick pay applications and refunds, pension reporting, AFP/AGA and A-melding submissions.
  • Act as the key contact for auditors, statistical reporting and external payroll-related enquiries.
  • Manage the relationship with our external payroll provider, including SLA follow-up, quality management, escalation of issues and reduction of rework and additional service charges.
  • Coordinate Timeplan – payroll provider – SAP integration topics, including interfaces, field mapping, testing and defect resolution.
  • Own monthly reconciliations of payroll-related balance sheet accounts and ensure aged items are investigated and cleared.
  • Import and validate statistical metrics in SAP and perform plan-versus-actual checks.
  • Maintain and strengthen the payroll control framework, including master-data changes, payroll calendars and approval processes.
  • Identify end-to-end process gaps and drive continuous improvement, efficiency and risk reduction.
  • Ensure key Norway payroll consolidation milestones are delivered accurately and on time.
  • Provide functional input and expertise for the 2027 payroll tender.
  • Provide clear timelines, checklists and expectations to hotel PMs/HODs, HR and Finance stakeholders.
  • Deliver targeted training and guidance to relevant stakeholders on payroll processes and requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships across HR Norway, Operations, Controlling, Accounting, HR Tech/IT and external payroll provider.
Qualifications
  • 3-5+ years of relevant Norwegian payroll experience, ideally covering payroll across multiple entities or locations.
  • Expert knowledge of Norwegian payroll legislation, statutory requirements and collective agreements.
  • Strong experience with Timeplan, payroll systems and SAP, or comparable ERP systems.
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations and accounting principles.
  • Experience managing or coordinating with an external payroll provider.
  • Experience with payroll systems integration and working with interfaces, data mapping, testing and issue resolution.
  • Strong analytical skills and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and multiple stakeholders.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll matters to both HR and non-finance stakeholders.
  • A proactive continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify issues and turn them into practical solutions.
  • Experience with project delivery or payroll transformation would be an advantage.
Additional Information

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development - helping you reach your full potential.

Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.

Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

Enjoy Global & Local Perks - No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide
Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & Family
Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and more

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Marketing Manager

Help more people find their way to Ängsbacka 🌿

Molkom, Sweden · Full-time · On-site

What if your next marketing job wasn’t just about selling something?

What if it was about helping people discover a place, a community and experiences that could genuinely make a difference in their lives?

Ängsbacka is looking for their new Marketing Manager.

We are a purpose-driven, non-profit community in the Swedish countryside, creating festivals, courses and volunteering programs around personal growth, connection, creativity and conscious living.

Now we’re looking for someone who can help us tell that story — and invite more of the right people to be part of it.

What you’ll do:

You’ll lead our marketing team and work directly with the CEO, taking responsibility for both the big picture and making things happen.

Your work will include:

    Developing and leading our marketing strategy
    Planning and executing campaigns and marketing activities
    Leading and inspiring the marketing team
    Strengthening and evolving the Ängsbacka brand
    Finding creative and unexpected ways to reach new audiences
    Creating marketing that makes people curious, excited and ready to join us
    Promoting our festivals, courses and volunteering programs
    Exploring new channels, ideas and opportunities for growth
    Turning the essence of Ängsbacka into communication that people can feel

Our main products are festivals, courses and volunteering programs, with a café and shop as additional parts of what we offer.

We’re looking for someone who...

Knows marketing — but doesn’t believe marketing has to look a certain way.

You are strategic, creative and hands-on. You can see the bigger picture, but you’re also happy to roll up your sleeves and get things done.

You might have experience in:

    Marketing and communications
    Brand development
    Digital marketing and social media
    Content and campaign creation
    Team leadership

But perhaps even more importantly, you are curious, proactive and good at turning ideas into reality.

You understand that people don’t just buy products. They join stories, communities and experiences.

And you genuinely connect with what Ängsbacka is about.

What you get:

This is not a high-salary corporate marketing position.

We want to be upfront: the salary is SEK 25,000/month.

What we can offer instead is something quite different:

🌿 Purpose — be part of a non-profit vision with a strong sense of meaning.

🤝 Community — become part of an active and inspiring community, with activities happening throughout the year.

🎪 Experiences — access to festivals and selected courses.

✨ People — work alongside great colleagues in a warm, creative and sometimes wonderfully unconventional atmosphere.

🌲 Nature — spend your working days surrounded by the forests and countryside of Värmland.

And perhaps most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to use your marketing skills to help create something you actually believe in.

Could this be you?

If you read this and thought “Yes. This sounds like my kind of place.”

We’d love to hear from you.

Location: Molkom, Sweden

Employment: Full-time, on-site

Salary: SEK 25,000/month

jobs.title: Barnevernskonsulent
jobs.description:
Sagene barneverntjeneste har i dag 47 stillinger, og er organisert etter en spesialistmodell. Vi holder til i moderne nye lokaler i Vitaminveien 4 på Storo.

Kontoret består av kontorfaglig team, mottaksteam, undersøkelsesteam, to tiltaksteam 0-25 år, omsorgsteam, samt et familieteam som utfører hjemmebaserte oppgaver på bestilling fra de øvrige teamene. Alle team ledes av en seksjonsleder, og teamene som ivaretar saksbehandling har fagkonsulent. Til barneverntjenesten hører det også et bokollektiv for ungdom. En av våre medarbeidere har fått nye muligheter og forlater oss, og vi søker derfor etter en ny medarbeider til fast stilling i det ene tiltaksteamet fra 01.11.26.

Ved Sagene barneverntjeneste er det stort fokus på å ivareta barneperspektivet, gjennom god forankring av Oslostandarden for samarbeid med barn i barnevernet og DCM barnesamtalen. I tillegg ønsker vi å hjelpe til med å mobilisere ressurser i familie og nettverk, f.eks. gjennom bruk av familieråd. Rutinene for vårt arbeid skal utvikles på bakgrunn av oppdatert kunnskap, bl.a. basert på barnevernsfaglig kvalitetssystem (BFK) som er integrert i vårt fagsystem Modulus og rettspraksis. Det har vært nyttig å tidligere ha implementert Kvellos metode for kartlegging og oppfølging av barn i risiko som en del av kontorets faglige forankring. Vi er opptatt av å ha tett samarbeid med øvrige lokale tjenester og tiltak. Det er stort fokus på fagutvikling og kompetanseheving, og alle ansatte deltar aktivt i dette.



Arbeidsoppgaver

Saksbehandling etter Lov om barnevern.

Hovedoppgavene er knyttet til arbeid med hjelpetiltak. Arbeidsoppgavene er bl.a. oppfølging av og samtaler med barn og deres familier, koordinere samarbeidsmøter, utarbeide planer, gjennomføre evalueringer og utføre noe veiledning.

Bistå i andre faser av barneverntjenestens arbeid.

Møte som partsrepresentant i Barnevern- og helsenemnda og øvrige rettsinstanser.

Holde deg faglig oppdatert og tilegne deg ny faglig kunnskap.

Kvalifikasjoner

Utdanningskrav: Sosionom eller barnevernspedagog. Det er ønskelig med relevant master.

Du må ha erfaring fra barneverntjenestens førstelinje. Annen relevant videreutdanning vurderes som positivt. Det er også en fordel dersom du har interesse for og erfaring med familieråd/nettverksarbeid, samt at du har kjennskap til BFK, Modulus og DCM (barnesamtalen).

Du har tydelig og nyansert muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne.

Du er opptatt av kompetanse- og fagutvikling, og vil således bidra til utvikling av tjenesten.

Krav til godkjent politiattest

Personlige egenskaper

Du liker å jobbe strukturert og systematisk, men har samtidig evnen og viljen til å være fleksibel.

Du har gode relasjonelle ferdigheter og du mestrer å være både ivaretakende og tydelig gjennom gode kommunikative ferdigheter.

Du har et tydelig barnefokus og er samtidig god på å tenke helhetlig og bygge på ressurser i familie og nettverk.

Du er en medarbeider som liker å samarbeide med kollegaer og aktuelle instanser. Du er samtidig selvstendig og kan stå alene i relasjoner og situasjoner.

Du ser at problemstillinger er komplekse og har mot til å fremme egne synspunkter og vurderinger.

Du er god til å prioritere, og du tåler arbeidspress.

Du leverer i henhold til tidsfrister og kan tenke alternativt når utfordrende oppgaver skal løses.

Personlig egnethet vil bli sterkt vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr

En veldrevet barneverntjeneste med engasjerte kollegaer og godt arbeidsmiljø.

En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag med krevende utfordringer.

Veiledning og tett oppfølging fra fagkonsulent og seksjonsleder, samt i gruppe.

Nye, moderne lokaler med kantine, treningsrom og sykkelgarasje sentralt på Storo.

Gode tjenestepensjons- og forsikringsordninger i Oslo pensjonsforsikring.

Avtale om bruk av fleksitid.

Lønnsplassering i lønnstrinn 35 til 44 i Oslo kommunes regulativ, avhengig av ansiennitet.

Det bes om at alle attester og vitnemål lastes opp i webcruiter, og at original medbringes på evt. intervju.

jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER DIG SOM VILL ARBETA SOM SERVICETEAMARE I GÖTEBORG/HISINGEN

Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med tjänster i hemmet så som städning, fönsterputs, flyttservice och mycket annat.

HEMSTÄDNING I VÄRLDSKLASS Att jobba med oss på hemfrid innebär att du får ett roligt, varierande jobb inom hemstädning. Som serviceteamare blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat team där du tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar för att göra våra kunders vardag enklare. Du kommer att arbeta med ett härligt gäng från olika delar av världen, där vi stöttar och hjälper varandra för att skapa bästa möjliga service.

Om rollen:

Som serviceteamare är du en del av vårt kvalitetsteam och arbetar nära Area Manager och Field Lead för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i vår leverans. Rollen innebär att du stöttar nya kollegor på fältet, samtidigt som du själv utför start- och storstädningar, fönsterputs och vikariepass. Du kommer även vid behov att genomföra kvalitetskontroller, följa nya medarbetare i deras introduktion samt avlasta med nyckelhantering.

Du är en viktig del i att skapa nöjda kunder, bidra till teamets utveckling och säkerställa att våra arbetssätt håller hög kvalitet. Rollen innebär också löpande dialog och återkoppling till chef samt deltagande i kvalitetsteamsmöten varje månad.

Vi letar efter dig som:

    

Tycker om att jobba i team med andra kollegor

    

Ha tidigare erfarenhet inom städning

    

Är engagerad och vill utvecklas inom städning

    

Pratar svenska eller engelska

    

Kan arbeta flexibla timmar, där arbetstiderna är kl. 8-17

    

Är flexibel att arbeta utan fasta kunder

    

Har giltigt körkort (B)

En tillsvidareanställning med en sysselsättningsgrad på 75-90%

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring, pensionsförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag

    

Utbildning inom hemstädning med fokus på din utveckling

    

Härliga kollegor från hela världen

We are constantly looking for staff who are interested in working with us in Göteborg/Hisingen and other parts of Sweden. Please visit our website www.hemfrid.se/karriar to see other cities where we are hiring.

Enjoy working in a team with other colleagues.

Wonderful colleagues from all over the world

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager - Power Conversion Solutions, Utility-Scale
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Regional Sales Manager to drive sales and business development for our power conversion solutions within the utility-scale renewable energy sector. In this role, you will build and strengthen relationships with key customers, identify new business opportunities, and play a central role in expanding our presence across the region.

Working as part of a small and agile team, you will enjoy a high degree of autonomy and ownership, with a strong focus on delivering ambitious sales targets. The position involves regular travel throughout the region and offers an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-facing environment. While the role does not include direct people management responsibilities, it requires strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions to achieve business growth.

How you’ll make an impact

    Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies for utility-scale power conversion solutions (e.g., inverters, converters for solar, wind, battery storage) to achieve regional revenue and market share goals.
    Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities with utility companies, independent power producers (IPPs), developers, and EPC contractors in the assigned territory.
    Cultivate and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients, understanding their needs and positioning Hitachi Energy solutions effectively.
    Prepare and deliver compelling technical and commercial presentations, proposals, and quotations to clients.
    Negotiate contracts, terms, and conditions to secure profitable sales agreements.
    Collaborate closely with internal teams including engineering, product management, project management, and legal to ensure seamless project execution and customer satisfaction.
    Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, providing valuable input for product development and strategic planning.
    Participate in industry trade shows, conferences, and events to promote Hitachi Energy's solutions and expand professional networks.
    Provide accurate sales forecasts, reports, and market intelligence to management.
    Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards.

Your background

    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field.
    Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive sales experience in the power conversion or renewable energy sector, with a proven track record of selling complex solutions to utility-scale clients.
    In-depth understanding of utility-scale solar, wind, and/or battery energy storage systems and associated power conversion technologies.
    Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and closing skills.
    Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers.
    Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
    Ability to work independently and as part of a global team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
    Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite.
    Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
    Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; proficiency in other regional languages is a plus.

The Sales Manager is responsible for sales, market development and customer relationship management for China Eastern Airlines in the Swedish market, with the objective of achieving sales targets and continuously strengthening the Company's market share and brand presence in Sweden and relevant markets.

Key responsibilities include:

    Maintain effective communication and coordination with China Eastern Airlines' headquarters in China and relevant business departments, possess a solid understanding of international airline sales operations, sales policies and relevant business systems, and be able to quickly undertake local sales responsibilities independently;

jobs.title: Senior Research engineer - R&D Downstream Process Development viral vector
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?  

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.  

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

We are looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join the Viral Vector Applications R&D section in Uppsala. The team consists of approximately 20 researchers focused on the development and optimization of downstream processes for viral vectors, plasmids, and nucleic acids, including purification, filtration, and analytical workflows. The work is closely connected to product development, translating process understanding into solutions that meet customer needs.

We are now seeking a new colleague who will work with downstream process development activities for viral vector manufacturing. The role focuses on developing, optimizing, and scaling purification processes, with particular emphasis on filtration and chromatography operations. The successful candidate will apply process understanding to improve productivity, robustness, scalability, and manufacturability while supporting the development of next-generation Cytiva technologies.

What You'll Do:

As a Senior Research Engineer, you will focus on the development, optimization, and implementation of filtration and purification processes for AAV and lentiviral vectors, including harvest and clarification of upstream material. Your work will span new product development, product care, and market support projects, always with a strong customer and process performance focus.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Driving process development activities within filtration and downstream purification, including experimental design, method development, and method verification to ensure robust and scalable processes.
    Applying a holistic understanding of the end-to-end workflow (Upstream to Downstream including analytics) to design efficient, integrated process solutions and provide technically sound recommendations aligned with customer needs and regulatory requirements.
    Independently planning, executing, and analyzing experiments in a structured and data-driven manner, and effectively communicating results in project teams and customer interactions.
    Owning and maintaining process-related infrastructure by ensuring proper use, calibration, and upkeep of instrumentation, as well as developing and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support reproducibility and quality.
    Evaluating, proposing, and implementing new technologies and technical solutions within your area, with a focus on improving process efficiency, robustness, and scalability.
    Contributing to scientific dissemination by preparing and delivering posters and oral presentations at conferences, translating process development outcomes into clear and impactful insights.

Who you are:

    You hold a MSc and have at least 5 years of industrial experience in biopharmaceutical process development, particularly within harvest and downstream processing.
    You have hands-on experience in developing and optimizing end-to-end purification processes, with a strong understanding of critical process parameters, scalability, and process robustness. Experience with viral vectors is highly desirable.
    You enjoy working in the lab, bringing structure to complex tasks, and take pride in maintaining clear, accurate, and well-organized documentation.
    You possess strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex process data into clear insights.
    You are fluent in English (spoken and written) and having working proficiency in Swedish in seen as a plus.

It would be a plus if you also possess experience in:

    Experience working with large-scale production equipment is considered a strong advantage and demonstrates your ability to bridge process development and manufacturing.
    You thrive on working in cross-functional teams, where collaboration and communication are essential to drive projects forward. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment and maintain a strong focus on delivering robust, customer-oriented process solutions.

jobs.title: Station Manager  China Eastern Airlines, Stockholm Arlanda Airport
jobs.description:
The Station Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient and compliant operation of China Eastern Airlines' flights at Stockholm Airport and for the overall management of daily station operations.

Key responsibilities include:

    Maintain effective communication and coordination with relevant departments at China Eastern Airlines' headquarters in China, possess a solid understanding of airline station operations and support functions, be proficient in relevant operational and business systems, and be able to quickly undertake station management responsibilities independently;
    Lead and coordinate station operations and related support functions, including maintenance, flight operations and ground handling, ensuring compliance with the Company's safety, operational and service standards;
    Develop and implement station work plans, budgets, operating procedures and management systems covering administration, personnel, training and asset management;
    Manage station personnel, including work allocation, performance management, attendance and training, while ensuring compliance with applicable Swedish employment and workplace requirements;
    Oversee flight operational safety, apron safety and the performance of contracted ground handling service providers, ensuring compliance with applicable civil aviation regulations and Company policies;
    Establish, maintain and implement station emergency response procedures, organize emergency drills and coordinate on-site responses to operational incidents;
    Monitor flight punctuality and operational performance, lead the handling of irregular operations, and coordinate passenger, crew and relevant service-provider arrangements;
    Coordinate major transportation and operational support assignments and, where required, support airport-related commercial activities;
    Maintain effective communication and coordination with airport authorities, ground handling companies, service providers and other relevant external parties.

The Station Manager reports directly to the General Manager of China Eastern Airlines' Stockholm Office and is accountable for the station's overall operational performance, safety and service quality.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a fast-moving tech environment where internal communication plays a key role in driving engagement, clarity, and participation. This role is about making communication happen, not just planning it. You will take ownership of campaign delivery from start to finish and help shape how important learning and development initiatives reach employees, participants, and leaders.

You will work hands-on across several channels and formats, turning complex messages into clear and engaging communication that people actually act on. The assignment suits you if you enjoy high pace, like building momentum around change, and want to have real impact through execution.

What makes this role interesting is the chance to own visible communication initiatives end-to-end in an environment where speed, relevance, and strong delivery matter.

Job Description

    You will drive communication activities for development-focused campaigns and program initiatives.
    You will create and publish communication materials such as SharePoint pages, email content, newsletters, and channel-specific content for Teams and other internal platforms.
    You will produce content in multiple formats, including short videos and participant testimonials.
    You will support the design of communication and workshop materials for learning-related activities.
    You will coordinate with stakeholders, participants, vendors, and other communication resources to gather input and keep delivery moving.
    You will align communication with central guidelines while adapting content to the right target audiences.
    You will help distribute program outcomes through the most effective internal channels.
    You will follow up on reach and distribution and provide reporting on communication activities.

Requirements

    You have senior experience in internal communications and can work independently from day one.
    You have a proven track record of running communication campaigns, not only supporting them.
    You are highly execution-oriented and comfortable owning delivery end-to-end.
    You are used to driving projects to completion with light direction.
    You are comfortable working in a compressed, high-intensity setting.
    You have experience producing communication in several formats, including short video, testimonials, SharePoint pages, newsletters, email, and Teams channels.
    You have experience coordinating stakeholders and gathering input from different groups.
    You have worked with campaign communication or behaviour-change communication, not only informational updates.

Nice to have

    Experience working with a tech organization.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: Maskintekniker till högteknologisk optikproduktion!
jobs.description:
WeStaff Sweden söker nu en maskintekniker till en modern och tekniskt avancerad industriverksamhet i norra Stockholm.

Företaget är en internationell aktör inom avancerad teknisk utrustning med kunder över hela världen. Här arbetar du i en högteknologisk och kvalitetsdriven miljö där precision, teknik och finmekanik står i fokus.

Nu söker vi dig som har ett genuint tekniskt intresse och trivs med att arbeta praktiskt med maskiner, problemlösning och underhåll. Du behöver inte kunna allt från start: rätt person får en gedigen introduktion och upplärning på plats.

Om rollen

Som maskintekniker blir du en viktig del av den tekniska verksamheten inom företagets optikavdelning. Du arbetar med att säkerställa att maskinparken fungerar effektivt och att produktionen kan bedrivas utan onödiga avbrott.

Maskinparken består bland annat av utrustning för slipning, polering och svarvning av optiska komponenter. Rollen är bred och kombinerar praktiskt tekniskt arbete med felsökning, underhåll och problemlösning.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Drifta, underhålla och säkerställa funktionaliteten i maskinparken inom optik

    

Felsöka och åtgärda tekniska problem och driftstörningar

    

Utföra reparationer och enklare tekniskt underhåll på maskiner och utrustning

    

Arbeta med maskiner inom bland annat slipning, polering och svarvning

    

Identifiera orsaker till fel och bidra till långsiktiga lösningar

    

Utföra förebyggande underhåll och löpande kontroller

    

Beställa material, reservdelar och komponenter som behövs för underhåll och reparationer

    

Samarbeta nära produktion och andra tekniska funktioner för att säkerställa en stabil drift

    

Dokumentera utförda åtgärder och följa upp återkommande problem

    

Bidra till förbättringar av maskiner, arbetssätt och tekniska processer

    

Arbeta utifrån instruktioner, teknisk dokumentation och gällande säkerhetsrutiner

Du får en varierad roll där ingen dag behöver vara den andra lik. Du blir en del av en tekniskt kunnig verksamhet och får möjlighet att bygga vidare på din kompetens inom maskinteknik, finmekanik och optisk produktion.

Ansvar i rollen

Som maskintekniker ansvarar du för att maskiner och utrustning fungerar på ett säkert och tillförlitligt sätt. Det innebär bland annat att:

    

Säkerställa maskinparkens drift och funktion

    

Felsöka och hantera akuta driftstörningar

    

Planera och genomföra förebyggande underhåll

    

Utföra reparationer och tekniska åtgärder

    

Säkerställa att rätt reservdelar och material finns tillgängliga

    

Dokumentera underhåll, reparationer och avvikelser

    

Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter i maskinparken

    

Följa säkerhetsföreskrifter, arbetsrutiner och teknisk dokumentation

    

Samarbeta med kollegor inom produktion och teknik för att minimera driftstopp

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är tekniskt nyfiken, praktiskt lagd och tycker om att förstå hur maskiner fungerar och hitta lösningar när något inte fungerar som det ska. Vi ser gärna att du har:

    

Tidigare erfarenhet av tekniskt arbete, maskiner, underhåll eller industri

    

Erfarenhet av maskinarbete, exempelvis svarvning, slipning, polering eller annan verkstadsteknik

    

Ett genuint intresse för teknik och problemlösning

    

Vana av att arbeta praktiskt och metodiskt

    

Förmåga att läsa och förstå tekniska instruktioner och dokumentation

    

Grundläggande datavana

    

God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Tidigare erfarenhet av maskinunderhåll, felsökning eller arbete med CNC och svarvning är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du har en teknisk grund, är nyfiken och har viljan att lära dig.

Du kommer att få mycket upplärning på plats och därför välkomnar vi även dig som har arbetat med maskiner eller teknik tidigare men vill ta nästa steg mot en mer renodlad maskinteknisk roll.

Som person

Som person är du lösningsorienterad, noggrann och ansvarstagande. Du gillar att skruva, felsöka och förstå varför något inte fungerar och framför allt tycker du om att hitta lösningen.

Du är strukturerad och metodisk i ditt arbete och har lätt för att ta egna initiativ när det behövs. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och samarbetar gärna med andra för att lösa problem och hålla produktionen igång.

Vi tror att du är en person som trivs bäst när du får arbeta nära tekniken och där din problemlösningsförmåga faktiskt gör skillnad i vardagen.

Övrigt

    

Start: Omgående enligt överenskommelse

    

Omfattning: Heltid, långsiktigt uppdrag

    

Arbetstid: Dagtid

    

Placering: Norra Stockholm

Vi erbjuder dig

Som anställd hos oss på WeStaff Sweden AB erbjuder vi en trygg anställning med kollektivavtal och ett närvarande engagemang. Vi arbetar långsiktigt med våra konsulter och vill att du ska känna dig trygg och uppskattad i din roll.

Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en tekniskt avancerad miljö, arbeta med modern maskinutrustning och bygga vidare på din kompetens inom maskinteknik och finmekanik.

Din nya arbetsgivare

WeStaff Sweden AB är ett växande konsult- och rekryteringsföretag inom Produktion & Tillverkning. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och långsiktighet.

Vi är ett kunskapsdrivet team med över 30 års samlad erfarenhet från branschen. Vårt arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och ett personligt engagemang. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

Vill du bli en del av oss? Ansök redan idag och bli vår nästa medarbetare!

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Esperi Hoivakoti Vanhakartano
jobs.description:
Hei lähihoitaja! Haluatko työskennellä paikassa, jossa asukkaat tunnetaan yksilöinä ja työkaverit pitävät toisistaan huolta?

Haemme nyt lähihoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Hoivakoti Vanhakartanoon Espooseen. Lue lisää alta ja hae osaksi meidän porukkaamme!

Esperi Hoivakoti Vanhakartano työpaikkana

Hoivakoti Vanhakartano on uusi ikäihmisten ja muistisairaiden hoivakoti, joka tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista 26 ikääntyneelle. Vanhakartano on aloittanut toimintansa keväällä 2026, joten pääset työskentelemään täysin uusissa tiloissa ja uuden työtiimin kanssa! Sijaitsemme luonnonläheisessä ympäristössä, Pitkäjärven rannalla Espoossa.

Mitä lähihoitajan työ pitää sisällään?

Lähihoitajana olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme arkea. Jokainen päivä tuo mukanaan kohtaamisia, pieniä onnistumisia ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa asukkaiden hyvinvointiin.

Työssäsi meillä:

- tuet asukkaiden toimintakykyä, hyvinvointia ja itsenäisyyttä

- toteutat yksilöllistä ja laadukasta hoivaa

- osallistut lääkehoitoon

- kannustat asukkaita yhteiseen tekemiseen, ulkoiluun ja aktiviteetteihin

- laadit hoidon suunnitteluun liittyviä arviointeja ja dokumentointia

- rakennat yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa turvallista, kodinomaista arkea.

Työsuhteen tiedot

Haemme lähihoitajaa vakituiseen, kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työ on 3-vuorotyötä. Aloituksen ajankohdasta sovimme kanssasi!

Palkka

Palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityistä sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Lähihoitajan pohjapalkka on kokemuslisistä riippuen palkkaluokan G20C mukaisesti 2527,97-2758,01 €/kk (1.9.2026 alkaen)

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

- lähihoitajan tutkintoa

- sote-ammattikorttia ja voimassa olevia lääkelupia

- hygieniapassia ja tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa

- vähintään toimivaa peruskielitaitoa suomeksi (B1-taso)

- katsomme eduksi aikaisemman työkokemuksen ikäihmisten parissa

Pyydämme lisäksi rikosrekisterilain mukaisen rikosrekisteriotteen nähtäväksi.

Miksi meillä viihtyy töissä?

Otamme sinut lämpimästi vastaan osaksi meidän porukkaamme. Varmistamme sinulle hyvän perehdytyksen ja saat koko työyhteisön tuen työllesi. Teemme töitä yhdessä tiiminä asukkaidemme hyväksi, tavoitteenamme laadukas hoiva ja hyvinvoiva henkilöstö. Meillä pääset työskentelemään upouusissa tiloissa nykyaikaisilla välineillä ja vaikuttamaan siihen, millaista arkea kodissamme eletään. Työntekijänämme saat Epassin virike- ja työmatkaedut, CityShopparin sekä työterveyshuollon Mehiläiseltä.

Kiinnostuitko tästä tehtävästä?

Jätä hakemuksesi järjestelmämme kautta 13.9. mennessä ja kerro meille itsestäsi! Huomioithan, että käsittelemme tietoturvasyistä ainoastaan rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta jätetyt hakemukset.

Heräsikö kysymyksiä? Lisätietoja antaa yksikönpäällikköön Lea Pyykkönen, p. 050 300 2412, lea.pyykkonen@esperi.fi

jobs.title: Research Assistant / Forskningsassistent (Academy of Finland-project REALS)
jobs.description:
About the job

This is a tight call for a Ukrainian-speaking RESEARCH ASSISTANT to be employed for project REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis and Hanken School of Economics.

Hanken School of Economics is a leading, internationally accredited business school, recognized for its international orientation and outstanding research quality in proportion to its size. We have close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 16 000 alumni. We are located in Helsinki and Vaasa, Finland.

Project

Project REALS explores how security is organised when formal systems are under strain, such as in times of war, disaster, or large-scale societal disruption. Bringing together perspectives from organisation studies, ethics of care, and arts-based research, the project extends understandings of security as purely institutional or technical. A central focus is how care, trust, and shared responsibility emerge in everyday practices when communities respond to crisis situations. The research draws on fieldwork conducted in Ukraine, including observations and interviews with emergency responders, humanitarian actors, and members of civil society.

Work

The tasks can be, but are not limited to:

- transcribing and translating interviews
- data search online (YouTube interviews, public media articles, reports, and other publicly available sources)
- participant recruitment and fieldwork activities, including identifying potential interviewees, assisting with interview scheduling and coordination, and, where appropriate, conducting interviews.
- assisting in the planning and organization of research dissemination and stakeholder engagement activities, such as seminars, workshops, and other communication events.

Employment: part-time employment (80 %), 1.10.2026-31.12.2026 (with a possibility of extension).

Job requirements

- good proficiency of English and Ukrainian, both spoken and written.
- good personal skills and ability to work as a member of a team.

- Please note that the research project engages with sensitive topics and contexts. Candidates should therefore be prepared to work with potentially challenging material and demonstrate an awareness of: emotional self-management and well-being, self-care practices when engaging with sensitive research data, ethical and secure data management. Training, guidance, and relevant support resources will be provided throughout the project.
- Familiarity with, and genuine interest in, the research context and subject matter will be considered a strong asset.

Documentation to be attached:

- CV
- Cover letter
- Language certificates if the skill level is not apparent in other attached documents
- Additional attachments, e.g. degree certificates, work experience and other merits that the applicant wishes to be considered

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (including employee healthcare, pension, and holiday contributions) and placed on job requirement level 4-6 for administrative staff, with an additional personal performance-based salary element.

For more details of the position, please contact the project PI, Anna Dziuba, anna.dziuba@hanken.fi.

Applications including the CV and other relevant documentation should be submitted in Hanken recruitment database LAURA no later than 06.09.2026.

___________________________________________________________

Forskningsassistent (ukrainsktalande) till projektet Finlands Akademi-projektet REALS vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan

Om positionen

Vi söker en ukrainsktalande forskningsassistent som ska anställas inom projektet REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan.

Hanken är en ledande, internationellt ackrediterad handelshögskola som är erkänd för sin internationella profil och höga forskningskvalitet i förhållande till sin storlek. Vi har nära samarbete med näringslivet och ett aktivt alumnnätverk med över 16 000 alumner. Hanken finns i Helsingfors och Vasa.

Projektet

Projektet REALS undersöker hur trygghet och säkerhet organiseras när formella system utsätts för påfrestningar, exempelvis under krig, katastrofer eller omfattande samhälleliga störningar. Genom att förena perspektiv från organisationsforskning, omsorgsetik och konstbaserad forskning utvecklar projektet förståelsen av säkerhet bortom rent institutionella eller tekniska perspektiv.

Ett centralt fokus är hur omsorg, tillit och delat ansvar växer fram i vardagliga praktiker när samhällen och lokalsamhällen hanterar krissituationer. Forskningen bygger på fältarbete i Ukraina, inklusive observationer och intervjuer med räddningspersonal, humanitära aktörer och representanter för civilsamhället.

Arbetsuppgifter

Arbetsuppgifterna kan inkludera, men är inte begränsade till:

- transkribering och översättning av intervjuer
- informationssökning på internet (YouTube-intervjuer, offentliga medieartiklar, rapporter och andra offentligt tillgängliga källor)
- rekrytering av deltagare och fältarbetsaktiviteter, inklusive identifiering av potentiella intervjupersoner, stöd vid tidsbokning och koordinering av intervjuer samt, när det är lämpligt, genomförande av intervjuer

jobs.title: Power System Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for aPower System Analyst to join our Business Development team.OurBusiness Development team supports market development and decarbonisation service activities globally by identifying, analysing, and developing new value propositions for our solutions by combining world-leading energy system modelling capability with market and business knowhow.
If you possess ambition, a forward-thinking development mindset, proactive problem-solving abilities, a keen willingness to learn, and a strong interest in professional growth, we may have the perfect opportunity for you. Whether you are a recent graduate or on the verge of completing your studies, we invite you to be a part of our multicultural and international work environment as we drive forward the energy transition.

About the position
This role provides a unique opportunity to support us in shaping the energy transition and the energy business atWärtsilä.The position will be based in Helsinki, Finland.

As a Power System Analyst, you will:
* Actively engage in and provide robust support for our global market development and decarbonization service activities, utilizing power system modelling tools such as Plexos – power system optimization software, Python and Excel-based tools. Leverage these tools to analyse opportunities and quantify system-level benefits.
* Conduct comprehensive energy market and country analyses to underpin project and market development initiatives, offering valuable insights and strategic guidance.
* Collaborate in supporting Wärtsilä strategy by contributing to the development of compelling value propositions, conducting feasibility analyses, and creating sophisticated analysis tools.
* Perform techno-commercial analyses for projects, playing a key role in supporting the sales organization and ensuring a thorough understanding of the market landscape.
* Effectively communicate and present analysis results to both internal and external stakeholders of Wärtsilä. This includes active participation in meetings, seminars, and other influential events where insights can drive informed decision-making.
* Take ownership of developing and maintaining power system models and feasibility calculation tools, ensuring their accuracy and relevance in the ever-evolving energy landscape.
* Contribute to the advancement of process-based system modelling, with a focus on data storage and handling, as well as result analytics and visualization. Stay at the forefront of developments in this field to continually enhance our modelling capabilities.


To be successful in this role, certain qualifications should align with your profile:
* Recently graduated from university or nearing graduation, with a major in economics, finance, operations research, computer science, or other quantitatively focused disciplines and a general understanding of modern electric power systems.
* Alignment with our core values – Customer Success, Passion, and Performance – should resonate with you, and you naturally embody these values in your daily work, demonstrating ownership and responsibility.
* Possess excellent analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, showcasing an ability to model and resolve complex issues.
* While knowledge of Python, Plexos or power system modelling software is advantageous, prior experience is not mandatory.
* Possess a basic understanding of data analytics and coding.
* Being a team player with strong interpersonal skills is crucial, along with a genuine interest in the energy business and enthusiasm for travel.
* Fluency in English. Other language skills are considered a plus.


Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact & next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadline of 11 September 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

In case of any questions regarding the position, reach out to:

Michael Ball
Director, Business Development, Wärtsilä Energy
michael.ball@wartsila.com

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoasentaja, Uusimaa
jobs.description:
Etsimme mekaanista kunnossapitoasentajaa Uudenmaan alueelle teollisuuden tarpeisiin!

Haemme asiakkaallemme pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen mekaanista kunnossapitoasentajaa. Työnkuva pitää sisällään toimipisteellä tehtäviä valmistustöitä ja asiakkaiden tiloissa suoritettavia huolto-, korjaus- ja asennustehtäviä. Työ painottuu vahvasti teollisuuden toimialaan ja työnsarkaan kuuluu paljon mm. manuaalikoneistamista ja TIG-hitsaamista, joista tulisi olla entuudestaan kokemusta. Työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää teknistä osaamistasi monipuolisissa projekteissa sekä kehittää ammattitaitoasi entisestään.

Työt alkavat sopivan henkilön löytyessä ja niitä on luvassa hamaan tulevaisuuteen saakka. Työt alkavat vuokratyösuhteisena, mutta hyvän tekijän on määrä työllistyä asiakasyrityksemme palvelukseen vuokratyösuhteen jälkeen.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* Kokemusta mekaanisesta asentamisesta/kunnossapidosta, TIG-hitsaamisesta ja manuaalikoneistuksesta - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa
* Voimassa olevat ammattikortit (työturvallisuuskortti ja tulityökortti)- jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
* Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan
* Pitkäaikaisen työsuhteen
* Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
* Perehdytyksen työhön.
* Jokaiseen tyotehtavaan soveltuvat tyovarusteet.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen helsinki(at)visiohr.fi. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Uudellamaalla työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Helsingistä käsin Ilmari, Mara, Abo, Joona, Miko, Dan ja Ville.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Uusimaa on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.
