jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Director of Product to join the AdTech team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

As part of our AdTech team, you’ll enable our partners to meet their future customers at the perfect moment. Through a range of products that we have developed to offer advertising solutions, we help restaurants increase their visibility and reach, improve their order conversion, and eventually drive more sales by covering the entire marketing funnel.

In this role, you will lead the development of key features of our Display products - we’re building some of the most successful and innovative Display products in the e-commerce industry. Our products enable vendors to rapidly grow their business in a targeted and customized way.

- Own the product vision and strategy to establish Display Ads as a key lever for Delivery Hero’s success in the marketplace
- Build a world-class suite of Display solutions focusing on ad experience, outcome oriented advertising, and optimization for long-term product sustainability
- Collaborate within a cross-functional team dedicated team comprised of commercial performance managers, data scientists and analysts, UX researchers, designers and engineers
- Align your ideas with our regional teams and get the buy-in from global and regional C-level stakeholders for your product agenda
- Join our large and growing global product community and act as a product champion and mentor

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience building digital Advertising/Rich Media products in a high-performance environment
- Strong track record of driving business results
- 7+ years of experience leading teams; ability to motivate and inspire others
- Demonstrated ability to work highly independently with a very high degree of ownership
- Highly analytical profile; ability to evangelise, explain and align the product agenda by reference to data and expected impact
- Strong ability to communicate, listen and negotiate to reach effective solutions in complex organizational environments
- Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week

- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.

You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

Denn die Syskron GmbH ist stolzer Teil von Krones.digital – einer internationalen Community aus digitalen Expert:innen der Krones Gruppe. Wir sind Fans von Cutting-Edge-Technologien und entwickeln innovative Services und Lösungen, die bei jeder vierten Getränkeflasche weltweit zum Einsatz kommen. Uns vereint der Anspruch, mehr als nur Häkchen auf To-do-Listen zu setzen: Wir wollen echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffen und die Getränke- und Liquid-Food-Produktion überall da optimieren, wo noch Luft nach oben ist, und so unseren Beitrag für eine nachhaltige und bessere Zukunft leisten.

Ja, das ist ambitioniert! Aber wir haben einen Plan, wie das möglich wird: Mit Menschen, die Chancen ergreifen, für ihre Ideen brennen und an die Power unseres Teams glauben. Mit offenem Ohr, wertschätzendem Austausch und gegenseitiger Unterstützung – im Büro, von zuhause aus, von überall aus der Welt. Mit kreativem Freiraum und einem inspirierenden Umfeld, das dich vorantreibt und persönlich weiterbringt. Das dir Sicherheit gibt und Platz lässt für dein Leben nach Feierabend.

Profitiere als Studierende:r von folgenden Benefits:

Wir bieten dir ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir uns auf Augenhöhe begegnen und besonders auf Fairness und respektvollen Umgang setzen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten sowie vielfältige Unternehmensrabatte unterstützen deine Work-Life-Uni Balance. In unserem Büro im Herzen der Regensburger Altstadt erwartet dich eine entspannte Atmosphäre, in der auch Hunde willkommen sind. Werde Teil unserer Community, in der alle, ob festangestellt oder studierend, gemeinsame Ziele verfolgen.

Let’s create impact beyond tomorrow – bist du dabei?

Aufgaben

- Du möchtest die industrielle Transformation aktiv mitgestalten und moderne Datenanalyse sowie Künstliche Intelligenz in echten Produktionsumgebungen anwenden? Dann unterstütze unser Team bei der Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für Condition Monitoring und Predictive Maintenance.

jobs.title: Manager, System Engineering - (Enterprise Infrastructure) (Cloud-Architect)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a System Engineering Manager (M1) to lead our combined Server/Cloud Infrastructure and Network Infrastructure teams within ETS / Enterprise Infrastructure, on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In this role you will manage two squads — a Server/Cloud team (on-prem and cloud workloads for internal users) and a Network team (office infrastructure) — as the technical owner and people leader for both:

- People & Team Health: Own hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, feedback, and growth plans across both squads; build an inclusive environment and address performance issues directly.
- Business Partnership: Translate stakeholder needs (IT, Security, Workplace Experience) into roadmaps for both teams, and prioritize work by business impact.
- Delivery: Maintain visibility into both squads' work, resolve cross-team dependencies, manage stakeholders, and track delivery/reliability metrics
- Technical Strategy & Operations: Guide architecture and operational excellence across both on-prem/cloud and network infrastructure (Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, multi-vendor hardware); own end-to-end Change Management within a structured framework, ensure incident response, and SLA-bound vulnerability remediation for both domains.
- Citizenship: Share learnings across teams and foster collaboration between Server/Cloud, Network, and other domain teams.
- AI Adoption: Drive AI as the default method for config generation, automation, and troubleshooting across both squads; ensure safe, policy-compliant use of approved tools (especially with sensitive topology, credentials, and cloud configs); coach engineers to use AI critically, track adoption and address resistance, and tie AI-enabled gains to delivery metrics and cost.

Qualifications

- Experience: 6+ years in infrastructure, systems, or network engineering, including at least 1–3 years in a people management or technical leadership role; prior experience managing or closely collaborating across both server/cloud and network functions is a plus.
- Technical Breadth: Working knowledge across on-prem and cloud server infrastructure (compute, storage, virtualization, major cloud providers) and enterprise networking (switching, routing, wireless, SD-WAN, firewalls).
- Multi-Vendor Exposure: Comfortable overseeing diverse hardware and platform environments (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Extreme Networks, Arista, Aruba, major cloud platforms) without needing to be the hands-on expert in every one.
- Change Governance: Experienced working within structured Change Control environments, reviewing technical plans, impact assessments, and rollback procedures.
- Security & Compliance: Understanding of security fundamentals across infrastructure and network layers, including vulnerability management and SLA-driven remediation.
- People Leadership: Track record of running effective 1:1s, performance reviews, and hiring processes; experience building team structure and growth plans.
- Certifications (nice to have): CCNP, PCNSE, cloud platform certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP), or equivalent.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

jobs.description:
Nothing provides more motivation than success. Da Vinci Engineering is highly committed to ensuring the own employees' success. Become a part of us!

Financial Reporting Specialist (m/f/d)

Stellen-ID: 22463
Standort: Raunheim

Your tasks:

- Take full ownership of local financial reporting governance in Germany, en sure the accuracy, timeliness and compliance of all financial reports in line with German Commercial Code (HGB), International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and group reporting requirements
- Manage and optimize local financial business processes, including but not limited to financial closing, reporting workflows, cost allocation and internal control procedures, to improve operational efficiency and ensure process standardization, which also includes cooperation with the company`s FSSC in Spain and Sweden
- Ensure strict compliance with German tax laws and regulations, including cor porate income tax, value-added tax and other relevant taxes, coordinate tax declarations, tax audits and tax planning work, and provide professional tax advice for business operations
- Collaborate closely with finance controller, understand R&D project financial management needs, be responsible for the accurate recording, classification and reporting of R&D costs, and support project financial analysis and decision-making
- Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports, conduct variance analysis between financial report and management report , identify potential risks and issues, and put forward practical improvement suggestions
- Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants to complete annual au dits and tax reviews, provide necessary financial data and supporting docu ments, and ensure the smooth progress of audit work

- Bachelor’s degree or above in Accounting, Finance, Economics or related majors; a master’s degree is preferred

- Proficient in German tax laws and regulations, with practical experience in tax decla ration, tax planning and tax audit coordination; familiar with Germany’s global minimum tax (Pillar Two) and other latest tax policies is preferred
- Fluent in both German and English (written and spoken), able to use them as working languages; proficiency in Chinese is a significant plus

jobs.title: Store Manager / Filialleiter (m/w/d) - Wien (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Was Dich erwartet

Unsere Mission ist es, eine Welt mit nachhaltigem Wohlstand zu schaffen.Suchen Sie eine neue Herausforderung und möchten Sie sich täglich weiterentwickeln? Dann ist dies Ihre Chance. Diese Position vereint anspruchsvolle Organisation, intensiven Kundenkontakt und verantwortungsvolle Mitarbeiterführung. Sie entwickeln und coachen ein hochmotiviertes, leidenschaftliches Team, um gemeinsam ambitionierte Ziele zu erreichen und zu übertreffen.

Wir bieten

- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung Bei Tesla profitieren Sie von umfangreichen Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung – durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen sowie vielfältige Weiterbildungsangebote (z. B. Produkt- und Verkaufsschulungen).
- Unternehmenskultur Tauchen Sie ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft täglich gelebt werden.
- Innovative Projekte und Technologien Sie arbeiten an wegweisenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien, die die Automobilindustrie und den Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie aktiv mitgestalten.
- Attraktives Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket Sie erhalten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalts- und Leistungspaket, das neben Tesla-Aktien (RSUs) oder einem Cash Award auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm umfasst.
- Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre Sie arbeiten in einem hochmotivierten, engagierten Team mit toller Stimmung und exzellenter Teamarbeit. Werden Sie Teil eines Unternehmens, das einen echten Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet.

Was zu tun ist

- Sie tragen mit fundierten Produktkenntnissen und überzeugenden Produktpräsentationen maßgeblich zur Geschäftsentwicklung und zur Erreichung bzw. Maximierung der Vertriebsziele bei.
- Sie motivieren Ihre Mitarbeiter nachhaltig und schaffen ein positives, leistungsförderndes Arbeitsklima. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören die Durchführung von Bewerbungsgesprächen sowie die Auswahl und Einstellung neuer Mitarbeiter.
- Sie planen und verantworten die Kosten und Ausgaben des Stores, einschließlich Personal-, Betriebsmittel- und Servicekosten.
- Sie erkennen kontinuierlich Verbesserungspotenziale in den Store-Abläufen, entwickeln Optimierungsvorschläge und setzen diese eigenverantwortlich um.
- Sie coachen und entwickeln Ihre Mitarbeiter systematisch weiter und fördern deren fachliche und persönliche Kompetenzen.
- Sie planen und organisieren verkaufsfördernde Events und Maßnahmen zur Erreichung und Übererfüllung der Verkaufsziele.
- Sie repräsentieren die Marke Tesla mit hoher Professionalität und tragen so entscheidend zu einer exzellenten Kundenzufriedenheit sowie zu deren langfristiger Bindung bei.
- Als Store Manager Sales & Delivery tragen Sie gemeinsam mit dem Service Manager die Gesamtverantwortung für den Standort.

Was mitzubringen ist

- Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb / Sales-Bereich mit und können eine nachweisbare Erfolgsbilanz vorweisen.
- Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung (People Management).
- Ein Hochschulabschluss oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.
- Sie zeichnen sich durch höchste professionelle Integrität, starke Eigeninitiative sowie exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten aus.
- Sie besitzen die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten klar zu setzen, mehrere Projekte parallel zu leiten und geschäftskritische Termine zuverlässig einzuhalten.
- Sie fördern eine konstruktive Zusammenarbeit im Team und treten als verlässlicher und vertrauenswürdiger Partner auf.
- Sie besitzen seit mindestens 2 Jahren eine gültige EU-Fahrerlaubnis der Klasse B.
- Sie sprechen ausgezeichnet Deutsch.
- Sie verfügen fließende Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2–C1-Niveau).Für diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttomindestgehalt von € 84.000 auf Basis des oben angeführten Anforderungsprofils bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung an. jobs.title: Senior Manager - Infrastructure Security (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security. In this pivotal role, you will lead the strategy for protecting our cloud and corporate environments by reducing real-world risk without slowing down the business. You will champion a "Secure by Design" philosophy, ensuring that security is a collaborative engineering challenge where automated guardrails and technical excellence enable our platform to scale rapidly and securely by default.

As a Senior Manager, you will build and lead a mission-oriented team of engineers, fostering a culture where technical excellence, automation, and professional growth are central to our operations. You will move away from reactive auditing, instead focusing on the engineering of non-negotiable technical gates that prevent misconfiguration at the source. Your leadership will be defined by the ability to co-design the "how" with Engineering and IT, co-authoring architectural blueprints that are technically viable and operationally frictionless. By driving the transition toward Security-as-Code and consistent enforcement across 100% of our assets, you will directly influence the resilience and velocity of the world’s leading local delivery platform.

- Lead and Mentor a High-Performing Team: Champion a culture of technical excellence and professional growth, enabling the team to drive strategic infrastructure resilience and long-term career success.
- Drive Infrastructure Security Maturity: Define the strategic roadmap for our core domains to ensure maximum risk reduction and operational efficiency across our global cloud and corporate infrastructure.
- Engineering Ownership and Enablement: Partner with tech verticals to provide the tooling, visibility, and expertise required for Engineering to own their security outcomes.
- Automate Preventive Guardrails: Replace reactive manual checkpoints with automated policy-as-code and admission controls to validate or reject changes before they reach production.
- Standardize Global Security Baselines: Eliminate ad-hoc configurations by architecting unified, version controlled security standards across our entire cloud and corporate infrastructure.
- Drive Vulnerability Governance: Architect scalable processes and automation to identify, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure risks, ensuring a measurable reduction in our attack surface.

Qualifications

- Proven Engineering Leadership: You have a track record of building and leading high performing engineering teams in complex global environments.
- Cloud Security Expertise: You possess deep technical knowledge of AWS and GCP security architectures including identity boundaries, network isolation, and resource hardening.
- Security as Code Mindset: You are proficient in driving automation through Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar infrastructure as code tools to enforce security standards.
- Modern Preventive Controls: You have experience implementing admission controllers and policy engines such as OPA, Gatekeeper, or Kyverno to automate production guardrails.
- Strategic Risk Management: You can translate complex technical vulnerabilities into clear business risks and prioritize remediation efforts based on actual threat impact.
- Collaborative Influence: You are an expert at partnering with SRE, DevOps, and Platform Engineering teams to co-design security solutions that enhance rather than hinder developer velocity.
- Operational Excellence: You have experience architecting vulnerability management programs that leverage automation to handle patching and configuration drift at a massive scale.

Nice to have:

- Large Scale Cloud Operations: Experience managing security consistency across a complex, multi-account environment within both AWS and GCP.
- Security Compliance: Familiarity with implementing technical controls to meet industry standards such as SOC2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.
- Advanced Certifications: Professional level credentials such as the AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or CISSP.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

jobs.title: (Senior) Netzingenieur*in (gn) im Produktmanagement digitaler Netzzwilling (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen nicht zwingend eine fertige Produktmanagerin und keinen fertigen Produktmanager. Wir suchen Netz-Know-how.

Darum geht es:

Wir bauen mit der gaia powergrids Modulsuite einen digitalen Zwilling des Stromnetzes: eine Plattform, die Verteilnetzbetreiber unter anderem bei der Anschlussprüfung und der Zielnetzplanung unterstützt – dort also, wo heute Excel, Erfahrungswerte und lange Wartezeiten für Anschlusskunden aufeinandertreffen.

Für die Weiterentwicklung dieser Modulsuite suchen wir eine Person, die Netzpraxis mitbringt und mit dem Produktmanagement die fachlichen Konzepte erstellt, validiert und das Anforderungsmanagement dafür übernimmt. Du weißt, wie ein Netz wirklich geplant, gerechnet und bewertet wird – und übersetzt dieses Wissen in ein Produkt, das Netzbetreiber täglich nutzen.

‍

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

- Federführung für die fachlichen Konzepte der neuen powergrids Module – von der ersten Idee über die Validierung mit Kund*innen bis zur abgestimmten Spezifikation.
- Fachliche Instanz für elektrotechnische und planerische Fragestellungen rund um das Produkt – du stellst sicher, dass unsere Verfahren dem Stand der Technik entsprechen und in der Praxis der Netzbetreiber tragen.
- Anforderungsmanagement: Anforderungen aus Kundenprojekten, Markt, Regulatorik und Datenanalysen strukturiert sammeln, schärfen und priorisieren.
- Übersetzen fachlicher Anforderungen in Konzepte, User Journeys und technische Spezifikationen – gemeinsam mit Engineering, Data Science und Design.
- Fachliche Bewertung von Netzmodellen, Netztopologien, Berechnungsverfahren, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen – und Ableiten klarer Produktentscheidungen.
- Einbringen deiner Netzperspektive in Produktstrategie und Roadmap, gemeinsam mit Product Owner und Produktleitung.
- Enger Austausch mit Pilotkund*innen, Partner*innen sowie unseren Kolleg*innen aus Sales und Customer Success.

‍

Das bringst du mit:

- Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium – Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit energietechnischer Vertiefung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Praxiserfahrung bei oder für einen Verteilnetzbetreiber bzw. Energieversorger in einer technischen Rolle mit Stromnetzbezug – also auch, wenn du diese Erfahrung als Dienstleister*in, im Ingenieurbüro oder in der Beratung gesammelt hast.

Zum Beispiel als:

- Netzplaner*in oder Grundsatzplaner*in (Mittel- und/oder Niederspannung)
- Netzberechner*in
- Ingenieur*in im Netzanschluss- oder Kundenanschlussprozess
- Asset Manager*in
- Mitarbeiter*in in Netzbetrieb, Betriebsführung oder Netzführung
- Projektierer*in oder Ingenieur*in in Netzdokumentation / GIS
- Fundiertes technisches Netzverständnis: Du kennst das Stromnetz und seine Betriebsmittel im Detail. Lastfluss- und Kurzschlussberechnungen kannst du einordnen und interpretieren – oder du bringst die Grundlagen mit, um dich schnell darin einzuarbeiten.
- Idealerweise hast du selbst schon Anschlussprüfungen für neue Anlagen in mindestens einer Spannungsebene durchgeführt und/oder eine Zielnetzplanung erstellt.
- Ein Gespür dafür, welche technischen Fragen ein Netzbetreiber beantworten muss, bevor er einen Anschluss zusagt oder einen Netzausbau beschließt.
- Analytisches, datengetriebenes Denken und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
- Freude daran, Komplexität verständlich zu machen und Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; gutes Englisch.

‍

Schön, wenn du es mitbringst – kein Muss

- Vertrautheit mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken zur Bewertung neuer Anschlussbegehren – in Deutschland z. B. VDE-AR-N 4100/4105/4110/4120 und die TAB, in der Schweiz die entsprechenden Werke von VSE und Netzbetreibern.
- Erfahrung mit Netzberechnungssoftware (z. B. PowerFactory, Integral, NEPLAN, pandapower, Sincal).
- Kenntnisse regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen in Deutschland und/oder der Schweiz (z. B. Netzanschluss, Ausbauplanung, EEG/Redispatch, Anschlussbegehren-Prozesse).
- Verständnis von Schnittstellen und Systemlandschaften beim Netzbetreiber (GIS, ERP, Leitsystem).
- Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, mit agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) oder in Softwareprojekten.
- Interesse/Know-how, wie KI, Simulationen und Datenmodelle in Softwareprodukte einfließen.
- Offene, positive Persönlichkeit, die den Austausch liebt und Freude an einem modernen, kooperativen Arbeitsumfeld hat.
- Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du kannst technische Zusammenhänge so erklären, dass Engineering, Design und Vertrieb sie gleichermaßen verstehen.
- Hohe Motivation, sinnvolle Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Spaß an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit – von Engineering bis Sales.

‍

Auch wenn du noch nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst:

Vielleicht hast du noch nie eine Roadmap gepflegt, kein Backlog priorisiert und noch nie das Wort „User Journey" benutzt. Das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du in einer technischen Rolle beim Netzbetreiber gearbeitet hast, das Netz und seine Prozesse wirklich kennst und Lust hast, dein Wissen in ein digitales Produkt einzubringen statt in die nächste Anschlussprüfung im Einzelfall – dann bewirb dich. Wir bringen dir das Produkthandwerk bei; dein Netz-Know-how können wir nicht ersetzen.

Das Familienunternehmen, zu dem die pädiatrische Praxis gehört, verfügt über mehrere Arztpraxen und ist mit einem guten Ruf in der Ostschweiz etabliert. Die Schweiz ist das Land mit den besten Ärztegehältern im europäischen Vergleich. Hinzu kommt der hohe Freizeitwert des Landes mit Bergen, Seen und attraktiven und sicheren Großstädten. Der öffentliche Verkehr gehört zu den weltweit besten. Die Schweiz liegt sehr zentral in Europa und verfügt über gute Verkehrsanbindungen!

- Sehr attraktive Vergütung – kontaktieren Sie uns gerne für Details!
- Betriebliche Altersversorge
- Interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Fortbildungen
- Sehr gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für Ihre Karriere als Arzt!

Sie profitieren von unserer langjährigen Erfahrung und unserem Know-how im Bereich der Ärztevermittlung

Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die warmherzig, diskret, verantwortungsbewusst und flexibel ist und Freude daran hat, Teil eines anspruchsvollen familiären Umfelds zu sein. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erwünscht; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Vorausgesetzt werden fundierte und nachweisbare Berufserfahrung in der Betreuung mehrerer Kinder, idealerweise in einem vergleichbaren gehobenen Privathaushalt; eine ca. 35 m² große separate Unterkunft wird gestellt. jobs.description:
Außendienstmitarbeiter Vertrieb (m/w/d) - Für Technisches Schuhwerk / Schwerpunkt Feuerwehr

Als Hersteller von hoch technischem Sicherheitsschuhwerk für die Bereiche Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienst, Polizei und Militär ist die Stumpp & Baier GmbH international präsent. Wir sind ein mittelständiges Familienunternehmen am Standort Heidenau bei Dresden.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams suchen wir eine engagierte Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die eigenständig handelt, Chancen erkennt und unser Feuerwehrgeschäft erfolgreich weiterentwickelt.

Das Vertriebsgebiet umfasst zunächst die Südhälfte Deutschlands sowie Österreich und die Schweiz – alternativ Ostdeutschland und Österreich. Im Zuge unseres weiteren Wachstums setzen wir die Bereitschaft voraus, perspektivisch auch größere oder zusätzliche Gebiete zu übernehmen.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie entwickeln unser Feuerwehrgeschäft systematisch weiter und werden an klar definierten, ambitionierten und realistischen Vertriebszielen gemessen. Dazu gehört:

- Aktive Neukundengewinnung und Ausbau unseres Feuerwehrgeschäfts
- Betreuung von Berufsfeuerwehren, Handelspartnern und weiteren relevanten Endkunden
- Eigenständige Entwicklung und Bearbeitung Ihres Vertriebsgebiets
- Erkennen und konsequentes Nutzen von Umsatzpotenzialen
- Unterstützung und vertriebliche Begleitung der Außendienstteams unserer Handelspartner
- Kundenbesuche und Entwicklung passender Vertriebsmaßnahmen
- Beobachtung von Markt und Wettbewerb
- Aufbau langfristiger und erfolgreicher Kundenbeziehungen

Ihr Profil

- Mindestens drei Jahre nachweislich erfolgreiche Berufserfahrung im Vertriebsaußendienst
- Hohe Eigeninitiative, Abschlussstärke und klare Ergebnisorientierung
- Gute Kenntnisse der deutschen Feuerwehrstruktur sind von Vorteil, idealerweise aus vertrieblicher Sicht; alternativ oder ergänzend ist Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Verbrauchs- oder Gebrauchsgütern wünschenswert
- Freude daran, Kunden und Vertriebspartner für anspruchsvolle und funktionale Produkte zu begeistern
- Hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft, Flexibilität und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Unser Angebot

- Attraktives Gehalt mit erfolgsabhängigem variablem Anteil
- Dienstwagen
- Firmenhandy und Laptop
- Eigenverantwortliches Vertriebsgebiet mit großem Entwicklungspotenzial
- Perspektive zur Übernahme größerer Vertriebsverantwortung
- Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für eigene Ideen
- Ein engagiertes Team und eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Geschäftsbereich

Wir freuen uns auf eine Persönlichkeit, die gerne etwas bewegt und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

jobs.description:
Empregado de Mesa

Descrição da empresa

You create experiences for our guests. As an employer, we create experiences for you. How? At The Cloud One, every day is unique. Never same-same, always thrillingly different. With us, you have the freedom to be who you are – or who you want to be. Because here, individuality is what matters. With equal – and exciting – opportunities for all. We believe in an inclusive culture that puts people like you at the heart of what we do, because we know that you’re the ones who make the difference. For us, respect and success go hand in hand. We’re locally rooted: connected to the city, its culture and its people. Are you with us?

Descrição do emprego

Estamos à procura de um(a) Empregado(a) de Mesa com paixão pelo serviço, atenção ao detalhe e vontade de proporcionar experiências memoráveis aos nossos clientes. A pessoa selecionada irá integrar uma equipa dinâmica e colaborativa numa unidade hoteleira em Lisboa, onde o foco está na hospitalidade genuína e no serviço de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Receber e acompanhar os clientes de forma cordial e profissional.
- Apresentar o menu, esclarecer dúvidas e fazer sugestões adequadas.
- Servir refeições e bebidas com eficiência, atenção e simpatia.
- Assegurar que todas as necessidades dos clientes são atendidas durante o serviço.
- Preparar e organizar mesas antes e após o serviço.
- Colaborar com a equipa de sala e cozinha para garantir um serviço fluido.
- Cumprir com os padrões de higiene, segurança e qualidade definidos pela unidade.

Qualificações

Formação e Experiência:

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções semelhantes (preferencialmente em hotelaria ou restauração de luxo).
- Formação na área de hotelaria ou restauração (valorizada).

Competências Técnicas:

- Conhecimento de técnicas de serviço à mesa.
- Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas de POS.
- Conhecimento das normas HACCP.

Competências Pessoais:

- Excelente comunicação e apresentação pessoal.
- Simpatia, proatividade e atenção ao cliente.
- Espírito de equipa e flexibilidade para trabalhar por turnos, fins de semana e feriados.
- Fluência em português e inglês (outras línguas são valorizadas).

jobs.title: TERAPEUTA OCUPACIONAL
jobs.description:
O Terapeuta Ocupacional com formação especializada na promoção da autonomia, funcionalidade e qualidade de vida dos indivíduos ao longo das diferentes fases da vida. Profissional responsável, empático e orientado para a pessoa, com capacidade para avaliar as necessidades individuais e desenvolver planos de intervenção adequados às características, objetivos e contextos de cada utente.

Destaca-se pela capacidade de estabelecer uma relação terapêutica de confiança, bem como pelo sentido de responsabilidade, organização, capacidade de adaptação e aprendizagem contínua. Valoriza uma intervenção individualizada e centrada na pessoa, promovendo também a participação ativa da família e dos cuidadores no processo terapêutico.
Apresenta facilidade em trabalhar em equipa multidisciplinar e em articular com diferentes profissionais e contextos, contribuindo para uma abordagem integrada e eficaz. Motivado para integrar uma equipa dinâmica e desenvolver continuamente as suas competências, procura contribuir de forma ativa para a promoção da autonomia, inclusão e bem-estar dos utentes, mantendo sempre uma postura ética, dedicada e profissional.

jobs.title: Night Audit (Night-Auditor)
jobs.description:
Night Audit

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 80 hotels in 12 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

- Processing booking requests

jobs.title: Care Worker
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
As a Care Worker at Bud Healthcare, you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality care and support to people with dementia, older people or people with intellectual disabilities . You will be responsible for assisting individuals with daily living activities, promoting their well-being, and ensuring a caring, safe and comfortable living environment. Key Responsibilities: As a Care Worker your role and responsibilities will encompass a wide range of tasks aimed at providing high-quality, person-centered care to our service users. These responsibilities include assisting with personal hygiene, managing medications, preparing nutritious meals, supporting mobility, providing emotional companionship, assisting with household chores, offering safe transportation, maintaining accurate records, effective communication, handling emergencies, pursuing continuous learning, and adhering to care plans. These responsibilities are essential in ensuring the well-being and comfort of our clients while upholding their dignity and privacy. Qualifications: Min of 1 year experience in a similar care role is preferred. A FETAC level 5 is desirable. Confidence in using IT/Email is also desirable. A caring and compassionate nature. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to follow care plans and instructions accurately. Reliable, Punctual and Trustworthy. Willingness to undergo background Garda checks and relevant training. Full clean driving license and access to a car is also desirable. Benefits: Flexible working hours. Staff Pension. Opportunities for career growth and development. Supportive and inclusive work environment. Ongoing training and education At Bud Healthcare, we are dedicated to providing the highest standard of care to our clients. If you are a compassionate individual who is passionate about making a positive impact on people's lives, we invite you to join our team as a Care Worker. Your commitment and dedication will be key to enhancing the quality of life for those we serve.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;
- Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analitycznego myślenia;
- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 100 hotels in 14 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

As a Receptionist, you are the first and last impression of our hotel, placing the guest at the centre of everything you do. From managing check-ins and check-outs to responding to guest enquiries and resolving requests with care and efficiency, you will provide exceptional service while working collaboratively with your colleagues to exceed guest expectations. - A warm, friendly and professional personality with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional guest service.
- A positive attitude, strong communication skills and the ability to remain calm and organised in a fast-paced environment.
- A proactive team player who takes pride in creating memorable guest experiences.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to multitask while maintaining high standards of service.
- Must be eligible to work in Ireland and currently resident in Ireland.

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ("Narodne novine" br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), Pravilnikom o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu („Narodne novine“ broj 1/96. i 80/99.) i važećim strukovnim kurikulom u obrazovnom sektoru elektrotehnika i računarstvo/računalstvo, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije kozmetičar/kozmetičarka u sektoru Osobne, usluge zaštite i druge usluge, strukovnom kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije automehatroničar/automehatroničarka u sektoru Strojarstvo, brodogradnja i metalurgija i kvalifikacije montera/ke strojarskih instalacija u sektoru Strojarstvo, brodogradnja i metalurgija, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije prodavač/prodavačica u sektoru Ekonomija i trgovina, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije konobar/konobarica, strukovnog kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije kuhar/ica u sektoru Turizam i ugostiteljstvo i Odlukom o donošenju odgovarajuće vrste obrazovanja za izvođenje nastave posebnih i strukovnih kurikula na razinama 3, 4.1 i 4.2 u strukovnim školama (Narodne novine, broj 83/2026) koji se odnose na potrebne kvalifikacije za oglašena radna mjesta.   • diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi

  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (“e-radna knjižica“)
  • prijavu na natječaj, vlastoručno potpisanu Navedene isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidat koji je izabran po natječaju dužan je nakon izbora, a prije sklapanja ugovora o radu predočiti izvornike traženih dokumenata.
Pri sklapanju ugovora o radu s izabranim kandidatom ugovorit će se probni rad sukladno zakonskim propisima i odredbi članka 25. Osobe koje sudjeluju u odgojno-obrazovnom radu s učenicima moraju znati hrvatski jezik i latinično pismo u mjeri koja omogućava izvođenje odgojno-obrazovnog rada. Radni odnos ne može zasnovati osoba koja je pravomoćno osuđena za kaznena djela iz članka 106. stavka 1. i 2. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, niti osoba protiv koje se vodi kazneni postupak za kaznena djela iz članka 106. stavka 1. i 2. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi. Pozivaju se osobe iz čl.102.st.1.-3. te čl. 103. st.1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17,98/19, 84/21, 156/23) i Zakona o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 84/2021,156/23) da su uz prijavu na natječaj dužne pozvati se na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima i uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti dokaze iz čl. 103. st.1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17,98/19,84/21,156/23) i Zakona o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 84/2021,156/23). Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva je : https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-u-drzavnoj-sluzbi/843 Dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na slijedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu sa Zakonom o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21) sukladno članku 48. stavcima 1. do 3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva je : https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-u-drzavnoj-sluzbi/843 Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja sa popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti prema Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92,77/92,86/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94,76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 94/01,103/03, 148/13,98/19) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom Zakonu, rješenje o priznatom statusu odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo navedeno pravo, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18,32/20) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom, odnosno javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju temeljem nekog drugog posebnog Zakona, dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti preslike rješenja ili potvrde o priznatom pravu te svu ostalu dokumentaciju temeljem koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti. Prije zapošljavanja, potrebno je priložiti izvornike rješenja. Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja i čije su prijave potpune i pravodobne provesti će se vrednovanje sukladno internom aktu poslodavca odnosno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Gospodarskoj školi Istituto professionale (KLASA:003-05/19-01/02 URBROJ:2105-21-19-1 od 13. veljače 2019. godine), a procjena/vrednovanje će se provesti usmeno – razgovorom/intervjuom s kandidatima. U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela i e-mail adresa ukoliko istu posjeduje), redni broj i naziv radnog mjesta na koji se prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama kojima dokazuju da ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja bit će pozvani na procjenu, odnosno razgovor - intervju pred povjerenstvom prema odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Gospodarskoj školi Istituto professionale, Buje KLASA:003-05/19-01/02 URBROJ:2105-21-19-1 koji je dostupan na mrežnim stranicama Škole (poveznica:https://web-arhiva.skole.hr/ss-gospodarska-buje/dokumenti_skole/pravilnici.html ) O točnom vremenu održavanja procjene i vrednovanja, odnosno razgovora- intervuja kandidata s Povjerenstvom, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem e-pošte ili telefonskim putem ili mrežne stranice škole sukladno propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka (poveznica: https://ss-gospodarska-buje.skole.hr/natjecaji/) Povjerenstvo u razgovoru s kandidatom vrednuje kompetencije značajne za područje rada (temeljem iskustva ili osposobljavanja), komunikacijske i socijalne vještine, motivaciju i interese kandidata za rad u Školi, snalaženje u novim situacijama, stil rada, očekivanja kandidata i slično). Povjerenstvo može zatražiti i održavanje oglednog nastavnog sata za nastavnike ili druge praktične provjere, sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Gospodarskoj školi Istituto professionale, Buje. Ako kandidat ne pristupi procjeni - intervjuu smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. U skladu s uredbom Europske unije broj 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17. travnja 2016. godine te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ broj 42/18) prijavom na natječaj osoba daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a sve u svrhu provedbe natječaja za zapošljavanje. Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom mogu se dostaviti na jedan od načina:
  • elektroničkom poštom na skola@ss-gospodarska-buje.skole.hr
  • poštom na adresu: Gospodarska škola Istituto professionale, 52460 Buje, Školski brijeg 1
  • neposredno u Gospodarsku školu Istituto professionale, 52460 Buje, Školski brijeg 1
s obveznom naznakom „za natječaj“ obvezno upisati radno mjesto za koje se kandidat prijavljuje ! Elektronskom poštom prijava se može poslati na adresu: skola@ss-gospodarska-buje.skole.hr uz obvezu kandidata da provjeri je li škola primila njegovu prijavu elektronskim putem. Rok za prijavu kandidata je od 26. kolovoza 2026. do 3 rujna 2026. godine. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve priloge navedene u natječaju i koja je pristigla u zadanom roku. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave na natječaj neće se razmatrati! S odabranim kandidatom sklopit će se Ugovor o radu. Natječajna dokumentacija neće se vraćati kandidatima. Prilikom zapošljavanja oba spola su u ravnopravnom položaju. Kandidati će o rezultatima natječaja biti obaviješteni putem mrežnih stranica Škole (poveznica: https://ss-gospodarska-buje.skole.hr/natjecaji/) u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora o radu sa izabranim kandidatom, osim ako posebnim propisom nije drugačije određeno. Objavom rezultata natječaja na mrežnoj stranici škole smatra se da su svi kandidati obaviješteni i neće biti pojedinačno pisano obavještavani. Sve kandidate izvješćuje se u skladu s odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za zaposlenike u javnim službama, na isti način i u istom roku. Pojmovi u tekstu natječaja koji imaju rodno značenje isto se odnose na oba spola. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stanicama i oglasnoj ploči Škole 26. kolovoza 2026. godine. Ravnatelj: Saša Stiković, dipl.ing

jobs.description:
Gospodarska škola Istituto professionale KLASA:112-02/26-01/03 URBROJ:2105-24-01-26-4 Buje, 26. kolovoza 2026. godine GOSPODARSKA ŠKOLA ISTITUTO PROFESSIONALE raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunu slobodnih radnih mjesta Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj: 87/08, 86/09, 105/10, 90/11, 05/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14,7/17, 68/18,98/19,64/20,151/22,156/23), članaka 16. i 19. Pravilnika o radu Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale, Buje (KLASA:011-02/23-01/3 URBROJ:2105-24-23-1 od 24.05.2023. godine,) Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Gospodarskoj školi Istituto professionale, Buje (KLASA:003-05/19-01/02 URBROJ:2105-21-19-1 od 13. veljače 2019. godine) i članka 127. Statuta Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale (KLASA: 011-03/26-01/01 URBROJ 2105-24-01-2 od 30. srpnja 2026. godine) ravnatelj Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale, Saša Stiković, dipl.ing., 26. kolovoza 2026. godine raspisuje : N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radna mjesta: R.B. NASTAVNI PREDMET/RADNO MJESTO UKUPNO SATI (određeno/neodređeno) UVJETI RADNOG MJESTA
NASTAVNIK/ICA FIZIKE Neodređeno nepuno radno vrijeme za 15 sati nastave, 27 sati tjednog radnog vremena, 5,4 sati dnevnog radnog vremena na upražnjenom radnom mjestu. Za ovo radno mjesto potreban je 1 zaposlenik/ica. Prof.fizike, magistar edukacije fizike, dipl.inž.fizike, mag.fizike Mjesto rada: Gospodarska škola Istituto professionale, Buje, u sjedištu poslodavca, a po potrebi i izvan sjedišta poslodavca, odnosno u izdvojenom odjelu Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale u Umagu. Radno iskustvo: nije važno Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova ( „Narodne novine“ broj 82/08, 69/17). Osim općih uvjeta sukladno općim propisima o radu sukladno Zakonom o radu ("Narodne novine" br. 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 64/23), kandidati trebaju zadovoljiti i posebne uvjete propisane člankom 105. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ("Narodne novine" br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), Pravilnikom o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu („Narodne novine“ broj 1/96. i 80/99.) i važećim strukovnim kurikulom u obrazovnom sektoru elektrotehnika i računarstvo/računalstvo, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije kozmetičar/kozmetičarka u sektoru Osobne, usluge zaštite i druge usluge, strukovnom kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije automehatroničar/automehatroničarka u sektoru Strojarstvo, brodogradnja i metalurgija i kvalifikacije montera/ke strojarskih instalacija u sektoru Strojarstvo, brodogradnja i metalurgija, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije prodavač/prodavačica u sektoru Ekonomija i trgovina, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije konobar/konobarica, strukovnog kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije kuhar/ica u sektoru Turizam i ugostiteljstvo i Odlukom o donošenju odgovarajuće vrste obrazovanja za izvođenje nastave posebnih i strukovnih kurikula na razinama 3, 4.1 i 4.2 u strukovnim školama (Narodne novine, broj 83/2026) koji se odnose na potrebne kvalifikacije za oglašena radna mjesta. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu s navodom radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje na natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis
  • diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona (ne starije od 6 mjeseci)
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (“e-radna knjižica“)
  • prijavu na natječaj, vlastoručno potpisanu Navedene isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidat koji je izabran po natječaju dužan je nakon izbora, a prije sklapanja ugovora o radu predočiti izvornike traženih dokumenata.
Pri sklapanju ugovora o radu s izabranim kandidatom ugovorit će se probni rad sukladno zakonskim propisima i odredbi članka 25. Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za zaposlenike u javnim službama („Narodne novine“ broj 29/24) osim za kandidate s kojima se u skladu s propisima ne može ugovoriti probni rad. Prema Zakonu o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 82/15,70/19, 47/20,123/23) za diplome stečene u inozemstvu potrebno je priložiti dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije te dokaz o priznanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije u Republici Hrvatskoj. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je stekao/la inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužan/na je, u prijavi na natječaj, priložiti rješenje o priznavanju inozemne kvalifikacije, sukladno Zakon o priznavanju i vrednovanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 69/22) te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 82/15, 70/19,47/20,123/23) rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije u Republici Hrvatskoj radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Osobe koje sudjeluju u odgojno-obrazovnom radu s učenicima moraju znati hrvatski jezik i latinično pismo u mjeri koja omogućava izvođenje odgojno-obrazovnog rada. Radni odnos ne može zasnovati osoba koja je pravomoćno osuđena za kaznena djela iz članka 106. stavka 1. i 2. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, niti osoba protiv koje se vodi kazneni postupak za kaznena djela iz članka 106. stavka 1. i 2. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi. Pozivaju se osobe iz čl.102.st.1.-3. te čl. 103. st.1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17,98/19, 84/21, 156/23) i Zakona o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 84/2021,156/23) da su uz prijavu na natječaj dužne pozvati se na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima i uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti dokaze iz čl. 103. st.1. jobs.title: NASTAVNIK/ICA HRVATSKOG JEZIKA I KNJIŽEVNOSTI
jobs.description:
Gospodarska škola Istituto professionale KLASA:112-02/26-01/03 URBROJ:2105-24-01-26-4 Buje, 26. kolovoza 2026. godine GOSPODARSKA ŠKOLA ISTITUTO PROFESSIONALE raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunu slobodnih radnih mjesta Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj: 87/08, 86/09, 105/10, 90/11, 05/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14,7/17, 68/18,98/19,64/20,151/22,156/23), članaka 16. i 19. Pravilnika o radu Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale, Buje (KLASA:011-02/23-01/3 URBROJ:2105-24-23-1 od 24.05.2023. godine,) Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Gospodarskoj školi Istituto professionale, Buje (KLASA:003-05/19-01/02 URBROJ:2105-21-19-1 od 13. veljače 2019. godine) i članka 127. Statuta Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale (KLASA: 011-03/26-01/01 URBROJ 2105-24-01-2 od 30. srpnja 2026. godine) ravnatelj Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale, Saša Stiković, dipl.ing., 26. kolovoza 2026. godine raspisuje : N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radna mjesta: R.B. NASTAVNI PREDMET/RADNO MJESTO UKUPNO SATI (određeno/neodređeno) UVJETI RADNOG MJESTA
NASTAVNIK/ICA HRVATSKOG JEZIKA I KNJIŽEVNOSTI Određeno nepuno radno vrijeme za 18 sati nastave, 36 sati tjednog radnog vremena, 7,2 sata dnevno za školsku 2026./2027. godinu. Za ovo radno mjesto potreban je 1 zaposlenik/ica. prof. hrvatskog jezika književnosti, mag.edu. hrvatskog jezika i književnosti, dipl. kroatolog, prof. hrvatske kulture, dipl. komparatist književnosti (ili prof. komparativne književnosti) pod uvjetom da ima položen razlikovni ispit iz hrvatskog jezika na Filozofskom fakultetu u Zagrebu Mjesto rada: Gospodarska škola Istituto professionale, Buje, u sjedištu poslodavca, a po potrebi i izvan sjedišta poslodavca, odnosno u izdvojenom odjelu Gospodarske škole Istituto professionale u Umagu. Radno iskustvo: nije važno Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova ( „Narodne novine“ broj 82/08, 69/17). Osim općih uvjeta sukladno općim propisima o radu sukladno Zakonom o radu ("Narodne novine" br. 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 64/23), kandidati trebaju zadovoljiti i posebne uvjete propisane člankom 105. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ("Narodne novine" br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), Pravilnikom o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu („Narodne novine“ broj 1/96. i 80/99.) i važećim strukovnim kurikulom u obrazovnom sektoru elektrotehnika i računarstvo/računalstvo, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije kozmetičar/kozmetičarka u sektoru Osobne, usluge zaštite i druge usluge, strukovnom kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije automehatroničar/automehatroničarka u sektoru Strojarstvo, brodogradnja i metalurgija i kvalifikacije montera/ke strojarskih instalacija u sektoru Strojarstvo, brodogradnja i metalurgija, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije prodavač/prodavačica u sektoru Ekonomija i trgovina, strukovnim kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije konobar/konobarica, strukovnog kurikulom za stjecanje kvalifikacije kuhar/ica u sektoru Turizam i ugostiteljstvo i Odlukom o donošenju odgovarajuće vrste obrazovanja za izvođenje nastave posebnih i strukovnih kurikula na razinama 3, 4.1 i 4.2 u strukovnim školama (Narodne novine, broj 83/2026) koji se odnose na potrebne kvalifikacije za oglašena radna mjesta. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu s navodom radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje na natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis
  • diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona (ne starije od 6 mjeseci)
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (“e-radna knjižica“)
  • prijavu na natječaj, vlastoručno potpisanu Navedene isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidat koji je izabran po natječaju dužan je nakon izbora, a prije sklapanja ugovora o radu predočiti izvornike traženih dokumenata.
Pri sklapanju ugovora o radu s izabranim kandidatom ugovorit će se probni rad sukladno zakonskim propisima i odredbi članka 25. Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za zaposlenike u javnim službama („Narodne novine“ broj 29/24) osim za kandidate s kojima se u skladu s propisima ne može ugovoriti probni rad. Prema Zakonu o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 82/15,70/19, 47/20,123/23) za diplome stečene u inozemstvu potrebno je priložiti dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije te dokaz o priznanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije u Republici Hrvatskoj. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je stekao/la inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužan/na je, u prijavi na natječaj, priložiti rješenje o priznavanju inozemne kvalifikacije, sukladno Zakon o priznavanju i vrednovanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 69/22) te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 82/15, 70/19,47/20,123/23) rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije u Republici Hrvatskoj radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Osobe koje sudjeluju u odgojno-obrazovnom radu s učenicima moraju znati hrvatski jezik i latinično pismo u mjeri koja omogućava izvođenje odgojno-obrazovnog rada. Radni odnos ne može zasnovati osoba koja je pravomoćno osuđena za kaznena djela iz članka 106. stavka 1. i 2. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, niti osoba protiv koje se vodi kazneni postupak za kaznena djela iz članka 106. stavka 1. i 2. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi. Pozivaju se osobe iz čl.102.st.1.-3. te čl. 103. st.1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17,98/19, 84/21, 156/23) i Zakona o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 84/2021,156/23) da su uz prijavu na natječaj dužne pozvati se na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima i uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti dokaze iz čl. 103. st.1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17,98/19,84/21,156/23) i Zakona o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 84/2021,156/23). Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) Osnovna waldorfska škola Zametska 6, 51000 Rijeka, e-mail: info@waldorf-rijeka.hr Objavljuje NATJEČAJ za radno mjesto:
  • WALDORFSKA UČITELJICA GLAVNE NASTAVE- RAZREDNA UČITELJICA– 1 izvršitelj/ica na puno određeno radno vrijeme
Uvjeti: opći i posebni uvjeti sukladno Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) te Pravilniku o unutarnjem ustrojstvu i načinu rada. Uz pisanu prijavu kandidat/kinja je dužan priložiti:
  • životopis
  • presliku dokaza o ispunjavanju uvjeta stečene vrste i razine obrazovanja
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od 30 dana), za one osobe koje su prijavljene
  • uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od mjesec dana od dana objave natječaja)
  • dokaz o državljanstvu
  • dokaz o završenoj (najmanje) dvogodišnjoj naobrazbi za waldorfskog učitelja na instituciji priznatojodmeđunarodne waldorfske asocijacije
Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenom presliku. U svrhu utvrđivanja vjerodostojnosti dokumentacije kandidata/kinje koji/a je zadovoljio/la u postupku, izvršit će se uvid u originalnu ili ovjerenu dokumentaciju, prije zaključivanja ugovora o radu. Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (preslika vjenčanog ili rodnog lista i dr.) Na natječaj se mogu javiti kandidati oba spola. Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužan/na je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti na koje se poziva te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan/na je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsimages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati /kinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18., 32/20.) uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN br. 84/21.) dužni su pored dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, dostaviti dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju koji se nalaze na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom/kinjom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Urednom se smatra samo prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. U skladu s uredbom Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata, te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Predajom natječajne dokumentacije smatra se da je kandidat koji je izabran na natječaju dao svoju suglasnost da mu se podaci navedu u odgovoru na natječaj. Rok za podnošenje prijava je osam (8) dana od objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama škole i Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Natječajna dokumentacija neće se vraćati. Obavijest o rezultatima izbora biti će objavljeni na mrežnim stranicama Škole. Natječajna dokumentacija dostavlja se u preslici u papirnatom ili PDF formatu na e-mail: info@waldorf-rijeka.hr ili preporučenom poštom na adresu: Osnovna waldorfska škola, Zametska 6, 51000 Rijeka. Priloženu natječajnu dokumentaciju ne vraćamo. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Škole, te na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 20.03.2026. godine i traje do 28.03.2026. godine.
