III. VERIFICA DELLE CONOSCENZE E DELLE CAPACITÀ DEI CANDIDATI In conformità con l'articolo 22 della LIPT, i candidati che intendono partecipare al presente Bando e che soddisfano i requisiti formali stabiliti dallo stesso saranno sottoposti a una verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità dei candidati, la quale consisterà nella prova scritta e nel colloquio di lavoro. Il candidato che non si presenti alla verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità sarà considerato aver ritirato la domanda di partecipazione al concorso pubblico. Regole per lo svolgimento della verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità I candidati devono presentarsi alla verifica muniti di un documento di identità valido. Accertata la loro identità, si procederà alla distribuzione delle domande. Per ciascuna parte della verifica delle conoscenze ai candidati vengono assegnati da 1 a 10 punti. Il colloquio si svolge esclusivamente con i candidati che abbiano ottenuto almeno il 50% dei punti nella prova scritta. Si considera che il candidato abbia superato il colloquio qualora ottenga un punteggio minimo di 5 punti. Durante la verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità non è concesso: - consultare testi od annotazioni; - usare il telefono cellulare/smartphone o altri mezzi di telecomunicazione; - abbandonare il luogo d'esame; - comunicare con gli altri candidati o disturbarli in altro modo. I candidati che trasgrediscono a quanto stabilito saranno allontanati dalla verifica in corso; pertanto, la Commissione non procederà alla correzione ed alla valutazione delle rispettive prove scritte. Luogo e orario di svolgimento della verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità Il luogo e l’orario di svolgimento della verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità, nonché l’elenco dei candidati che soddisfano i requisiti formali del Bando, saranno pubblicati sul sito web della Città di Umag – Umago o all’indirizzo www.umag.hr (pagina “Offerte di lavoro”) ed affissi all'albo pretorio in Piazza Libertà 7, piano terra, almeno 5 giorni prima della data della verifica. Oltre al giorno e all'ora della prova, nella lista dei candidati saranno riportate rispettivamente le iniziali del candidato, l'anno di nascita e il luogo di residenza. Ulteriori estremi potranno essere inclusi qualora due o più candidati riportino dati identici. IV. jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) - Remote (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
jobs.description:
Remote Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. At OnlineDoctor AG we are looking for a System engineer! Our tech stack: AI, Atlassian, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Microsoft 365, Security, Slack, Office 365. Requirements: - Proven hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 at the tenant level (user lifecycle, groups, roles, licensing, security settings, integrations)

- Strong understanding of access control principles: authentication, authorization, SSO, and identity management
- Experience administering Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence) including workflow design and governance
- Demonstrated ability to establish scalable governance standards across a tooling ecosystem and improve operations independently
- Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities are: Microsoft 365 & Identity
- Serve as the tenant-level administrator for Microsoft 365, owning configuration, security settings, and feature management
- Manage the full user lifecycle: provisioning, role assignment, license management, and offboarding
- Design and enforce access control policies, including group structures, permissions, and role-based access

Tool Ownership

- Own the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of all company tools including Slack, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and others
- Support teams in configuring workflows and collaboration structures that fit how they work
- Manage vendor relationships, renewals, and license optimization to control costs

Automation & Operation

- Build and maintain secure integrations between internal tools to improve workflow consistency and reduce manual work
- Automate repetitive operational processes such as onboarding/offboarding, license provisioning, and access requests
- Maintain clear documentation for configurations, integrations and operational procedures
- Provide reliable support, monitor critical tools and lead incident responses for outages, access issues and integration failures. Category: System Developer / Engineer Location address: Waisenhaustrasse 15, Munich, Germany. Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine startup focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to take pictures of their skin issues and receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for a Systems Administrator to take full ownership of our internal tooling landscape and IT operations. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who is self-directed, detail-oriented, and passionate about improving and professionalizing reliable, secure, and well-governed systems.

You will be the owner of our internal tool ecosystem — responsible for access control, security, integrations, cost management, and operational continuity across all platforms. You will establish clear governance and standards, improve how we provision and protect our tools, and ensure every employee has seamless, secure access to what they need.

What we offer:

- Flexibility: You decide if you want to work remote or if you prefer to visit one of our Offices (Hamburg, St. Gallen, Zürich). We offer you a flexible schedule and a working time model that suits you.
- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

Ready to Join Us?
If weve convinced you, get in touch to apply for this position. We look forward to meeting you soon!  last updated 34 week of 2026

jobs.title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Web Infrastructure team builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients, including client architecture, performance, reliability, and shared design systems.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the team through the evolution from Notion Clients. You’ll set strategy, develop senior engineers and managers, and partner across Notion to make the product faster, more reliable, and easier to build.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You'll build and manage a diverse and inclusive team of engineers and managers working on core parts of Notion's architecture. You'll create a healthy environment in your team that embodies Notion's values.

 - You'll recruit, coach, and develop engineers. You'll ensure engineers are regularly receiving feedback and making progress on personal and professional goals.

 - You'll facilitate planning—the prioritization, sequencing, and staffing of work—for your team.

 - You'll be responsible for maintaining a high-quality bar for everything your team ships.

 - You'll own execution in your team to develop a steady cadence of delivering value to your users.

 - You'll work with others to shape how Notion's engineering organization works. You'll help develop our technical practices, recruiting and onboarding strategy, planning and prioritization process, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have managed senior engineering teams and managers, and have experience in scaling teams.

 - You have built, or are committed to building, diverse and inclusive teams.

 - You create team environments that are at once collaborative, empowering, supportive, and challenging—ones where engineers do their best work.

 - You have a sufficiently deep background in product and technology that you can ask the right questions of your team, balance product, tech, and people concerns, and make hard tradeoffs.

 - You think rigorously. You're prepared to tackle the toughest technical problems, understand trade-offs, and enable teams to make decisions and progress.

 - You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and change, especially around organizational structure and the boundaries of your role. You enjoy jumping into whatever areas need attention and learning as-you-go.

 - You value empathetic and direct communication, particularly when giving and receiving feedback.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have managed engineering teams at startups before, particularly during periods of rapid growth and organizational change.

 - You have experience rolling out engineering and management practices and processes—e.g., code review, performance reviews, and levels and ladders—where they didn't exist before.

 - You've managed teams that are across multiple offices.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 - $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Cuisinier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig
jobs.description:
Vil du tage teknisk ansvar for vores Shopify-platforme og samtidig selv være hands-on i udviklingen?

Så skal du læse med her!

Vi søger en erfaren Shopify Plus udvikler til rollen som Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig, hvor du både bliver hands-on i koden og får et centralt teknisk ansvar. Du kommer til at løse komplekse problemer, bygge solide og skalerbare løsninger og få stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi videreudvikler vores e-commerce-platforme, tekniske standarder og løsninger på tværs af vores forretning.

Om GrejFreak.dk

GrejFreak.dk er Danmarks førende onlineforhandler af outdoor-, jagt- og militærudstyr. Vi leverer grej til både friluftsfolk, professionelle og helt almindelige danskere, der sætter pris på godt udstyr. Salget sker primært gennem GrejFreak.dk, men vi driver også andre webshops i Danmark og på internationale markeder.

Vi er en ambitiøs vækstvirksomhed med fokus på innovation, samarbejde og høj faglighed. Her er der plads til gode idéer, og vi lægger vægt på, at de hurtigt kan omsættes til handling.

Vores e-commerce-forretning er i vækst, og vi har mange spændende digitale initiativer foran os. Derfor ønsker vi at styrke vores interne tekniske kompetencer med en erfaren Shopify-specialist.

Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Bidrage til den tekniske opbygning af nye shops, markeder og digitale koncepter, herunder GrejFreak.dk, GearFreak.de, ReadyBox.dk samt nye webshops til vores private label brands.

  • Arbejde med integrationer mellem Shopify og øvrige forretnings- og marketingplatforme.

  • Sikre en struktureret udviklingsproces med versionsstyring, test, kvalitetssikring og dokumentation.

  • Udvikle interne værktøjer, automatiseringer og AI-understøttede løsninger, der kan effektivisere arbejdsgange og gøre hverdagen lettere for kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

  • Fejlfinde og optimere eksisterende løsninger.

  • Vurdere tekniske løsningsmuligheder og rådgive om, hvornår noget bør udvikles, løses med standardfunktionalitet eller via tredjepartsløsninger.

  • Samarbejde med og kvalitetssikre leverancer fra eksterne udviklingspartnere.

  • Bidrage til fælles tekniske standarder og en robust, vedligeholdelsesvenlig platform.

Du bliver samtidig teknisk platformansvarlig og får en vigtig rolle i at skabe fælles tekniske standarder på tværs af vores webshops.

Det indebærer blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Sikre fælles tekniske standarder og en struktureret udviklingsproces.

  • Bidrage til en stabil, skalerbar og vedligeholdelsesvenlig Shopify-platform.

  • Dokumentere væsentlige tekniske løsninger og ændringer.

  • Vurdere tekniske risici og sikre robuste løsninger på tværs af vores webshops.

  • Sikre, at platformen og den tekniske viden er godt forankret internt.

Teknisk sparringspartner

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens øvrige teams og omsætte forretningsbehov til gode tekniske løsninger.

Vi forventer, at du kan rådgive om den bedste tekniske tilgang, udfordre unødigt komplekse løsninger og tænke i kvalitet, genbrugelighed og langsigtet vedligeholdelse.

Du skal med andre ord ikke blot implementere krav, men aktivt bidrage med teknisk sparring og foreslå den bedste vej frem.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har solid professionel erfaring med Shopify Plus og udvikling af skræddersyede Shopify-løsninger.

  • Har stærke kompetencer i Shopify Liquid samt HTML, CSS og JavaScript.

  • Har erfaring med theme development, custom komponenter og moderne udviklingsværktøjer.

  • Har arbejdet med API’er, integrationer og tekniske løsninger på tværs af systemer.

  • Har god forståelse for performance, tracking og de tekniske krav til en moderne e-commerce-platform.

  • Arbejder struktureret med kode, versionsstyring, test og dokumentation.

  • Kan fejlfinde systematisk og tage ansvar for løsninger fra idé til drift.

  • Har blik for, hvornår en løsning bør bygges, tilpasses eller løses med eksisterende funktionalitet.

  • Kan formidle tekniske problemstillinger klart til kolleger uden teknisk baggrund.

  • Tør udfordre løsninger fagligt og foreslå bedre eller mere enkle alternativer.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og trives samtidig med tæt samarbejde på tværs af virksomheden.

Erfaring med TypeScript, internationale Shopify-setups, A/B-testing og relevante e-commerce- eller marketingintegrationer er en fordel.

Det vigtigste er, at du er en erfaren Shopify-udvikler, som kan tage et reelt teknisk ejerskab og bidrage aktivt til den videre udvikling af vores platforme.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central teknisk rolle i en ambitiøs e-commerce-virksomhed i vækst.

  • Stor indflydelse på den tekniske udvikling af vores Shopify-platforme.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde hands-on med udvikling og sætte et tydeligt teknisk aftryk.

  • En varieret hverdag med både videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger og opbygning af nye digitale initiativer.

  • Mulighed for at præge tekniske standarder, arkitektur og udviklingsprocesser.

  • Tæt samarbejde med e-commerce, marketing og øvrige relevante funktioner.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger.

  • Attraktive medarbejderfordele, herunder rabat på vores sortiment og sociale arrangementer.

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi har ikke brug for en lang, klassisk ansøgning. Send os dit CV og fortæl kort om dig selv og din erfaring til HR@grejfreak.dk med emnefeltet “Senior Shopify Developer”

Vi vil gerne høre:

  1. Hvad arbejder du med i dag, og hvad har bragt dig frem til Shopify-udvikling?

  2. Hvilken Shopify-erfaring har du, som du mener er mest relevant for rollen?

  3. Beskriv en teknisk løsning eller udfordring, du har arbejdet med, som du er særligt tilfreds med.

  4. Hvilke typer udviklingsopgaver motiverer dig mest?

  5. Hvordan bruger du AI eller andre udviklingsværktøjer i dit daglige arbejde?

Du er også meget velkommen til at sende links til LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio eller løsninger, du har været med til at udvikle.

Stilling opslået: 26. august 2026
Ansøgningsfrist: 14. oktober 2026 - vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.
Forventet opstart: Efter aftale

jobs.title: Independent B2B Sales Partner – 3D Visualization, Product Configurators and VR
jobs.description:
I am Soyhan Yazgan, a software developer based in Orimattila, Finland. I have six years of software-consulting experience, including 4.5 years working on an Unreal Engine–based digital instrument-cluster project for Ford Motor Company.

I hold a bachelors degree in Software Engineering from Metropolia University of Applied Sciences and a masters degree in Game Business Management from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. My core tools include Unreal Engine, 3ds Max, Corona Renderer and V-Ray.

I am now establishing an independent 3D/VR development studio and looking for a B2B sales partner whose commercial and relationship-building skills complement my technical expertise.

**What we would initially sell**

- Pre-rendered and real-time 3D visualization for architecture, machinery, furniture and vehicles, including still images, animations, interactive walkthroughs, and imagery for websites and print catalogs

- Interactive configurators for vehicles, kitchens, furniture systems, industrial equipment and other modular products

- VR or desktop-based product demonstrations, technical training applications and simulations


Potential customers include industrial manufacturers, training providers, construction and real estate companies, and marketing or design agencies that need a reliable white-label technical partner.

Typical projects run from several weeks to several months, with budgets of approximately €5,000–€30,000 excluding VAT, depending on scope. Engagements may begin as paid pilot projects, develop into recurring production work, or be delivered as larger phased projects.

**Your role**

- Identify and approach suitable B2B prospects

- Reach the appropriate decision-makers and qualify opportunities

- Arrange and lead introductory sales conversations

- Join discovery, proposal and negotiation meetings

- Help position the solution around the customers business problem

- Attend relevant trade fairs or customer meetings when mutually agreed


I will handle technical discovery, demonstrations, estimates, project scoping and delivery. We will agree on pricing boundaries together, and no proposal will be submitted without mutual approval.

**Commercial arrangement**

This is initially a flexible, non-exclusive independent partnership; not salaried employment. There is currently no guaranteed retainer or minimum number of hours.

Proposed commission model:

- 20% of collected project revenue, excluding VAT and agreed third-party expenses, for clients you source and actively help close


Commission would be paid proportionally as customer payments are received. Lead ownership, existing contacts, repeat projects, cancellations and post-termination commissions would be defined in a written agreement before outreach begins.

The arrangement is particularly suitable for an independent sales professional or agency that already serves relevant B2B customers and wants to add 3D, Unreal Engine or VR services to its offering.

**You may be a good fit if you have**

- Experience selling custom B2B services or technology projects

- Professional Finnish and English communication skills

- Strong prospecting, relationship-building and negotiation skills

- Contacts in manufacturing, training, construction, real estate or marketing

- The ability to work independently and represent technical services professionally


A particular degree is not required. Relevant results, relationships and business judgement are more important.

**Interested?**

Please send me:

- A short introduction

- Your LinkedIn profile

- The sectors in which you have experience or contacts

- An example of a B2B service or project you have helped sell


Email: soyhan15@gmail.com

I would be happy to arrange an introductory meeting to discuss the offering, target customers and cooperation model.

Soyhan Yazgan

jobs.title: Key Account Manager

Bliv en nøglespiller i vores globale vækst

Har du en stærk kommerciel og teknisk profil – og trives du med at eje dit eget marked? Er du vant til at navigere i komplekse, kundetilpassede løsninger og opbygge langsigtede relationer på beslutningstagerniveau?

Hos Kallesoe Machinery A/S bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor innovation, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd. Vores anlæg er unikke og skræddersyet til komplekse kundebehov, og som Key Account Manager får du det fulde ansvar for at udvikle og fastholde relationerne til dine nøglekunder.

  • Udvikling og forhandling af komplekse, kundespecifikke tilbud med fokus på kundeværdi, ROI og langsigtede partnerskaber
  • Selvstændig ledelse af kundemøder og forhandlinger – nationalt og internationalt – som strategisk sparringspartner på beslutningstagerniveau
  • Ansvar for kapacitetsberegninger og tekniske analyser, der dokumenterer produktivitet, effektivitet og investeringsafkast for kunden
  • Udvikling af salgs- og beslutningsmateriale der tydeliggør løsningens værdi i kundens produktion

  • Tæt samarbejde med produktion, projektledelse og øvrige Sales Managers om at sikre kundens oplevelse gennem hele salgsprocessen

Du bygger bro mellem teknik og strategisk salg – og bliver den stemme, kunder og kolleger søger, når kompleksiteten stiger.

  • Har en teknisk uddannelse, fx maskiningeniør, maskinmester eller tilsvarende

  • Stor frihed og fleksibilitet i planlægningen af dit arbejdsliv
  • Attraktive personalefordele, herunder sundhedsforsikring og aktiv personaleforening
Om Kallesoe Machinery A/S

Kallesoe Machinery A/S er en moderne, innovativ og højteknologisk virksomhed med base i Lem ved Ringkøbing. Vi udvikler og producerer avancerede systemløsninger til den bæredygtige byggeindustri i træ – og bidrager aktivt til en grønnere og mere ressourceeffektiv byggebranche globalt. Kallesoe er en del af den tyske HOMAG Group, som indgår i Dürr-koncernen. Hos os kombinerer vi global styrke med lokal forankring. Samarbejde er ikke bare et værktøj – det er en kultur. jobs.description:
You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ constructive feedbackÂ on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We're proud to have assembledÂ a remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at leastÂ 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have aÂ network among designers you respect, and you'reÂ comfortable writing to someone you admireÂ and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy toÂ engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ see what's missingÂ before anyone builds it.

  • You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • Youâre aÂ forward thinkerÂ who isnât afraid to innovate and try new things before others have.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • YouâreÂ eager to help people build UX and UI skillsÂ because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You canÂ teach a career changerÂ the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designerÂ in upskilling. Perhaps you've mentored people, or youâve run your own company helping clients level up.

  • YouÂ give constructive feedback people can act on, and you can tell a talented colleague how they can improve their work without them becoming defensive.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education.

  • You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken EnglishÂ and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • If you still love designing in Figma and building interfaces with AI, there's room for that here. Some of our Course Directors design hands-on; others have moved fully into direction. Both work for us.

  • Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a yearÂ to shoot courses.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ led a design team.

  • YouÂ publish your own thinking on design: articles, a book, educational material, a blog, or a social media presence.

  • You'veÂ spoken at design conferences, or you're on a first-name basis with people who do.

  • You'veÂ created design systems. Organizing complex material so other people can put it to use is a lot of what you'll be doing.

  • You've worked as anÂ editor, or you've createdÂ online courses.

  • You have the graphic design skills to create image-based and interactive content for courses, articles, and social media.

  • You'veÂ built AI-supported learning toolsÂ yourself, or you've used AI to build products.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in UX, UI, HCI,Â AI, or a similar field.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field.Â A design leader might shape the work of thirty people on their team. Your decisions about what we teach will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

  • Access:Â the designers you'd normally see on a conference stage are the people you'll email, plan with, and sit across from in a studio. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

  • Autonomy: Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in.

She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • Colleagues with four to forty years of experience, and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest rÃ©sumÃ©.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

jobs.title: Ravintolatyöntekijä Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORI

Ravintolatyöntekijäksi Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan

Haemme Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan kokous- ja tilausravintolaan ravintolatyöntekijöitä työskentelemään keittiön ja salin puolen työtehtävissä läpi pikkujoulusesongin. Tehtävät ovat osa-aikaisia, 10-20 h/vko ja määräaikaisia vuoden loppuun. Työn aloituksesta on mahdollista sopia joustavasti. Kyseessä on iltapainotteinen vaihteleva vuorotyö ja työskentelemme niin arkena kuin myös juhlapyhinä!

Tule kanssamme työskentelemään kiireisimmän ja upeimman juhlasesonkimme, eli pikkujoulusesongin läpi!

Ravintolatyöntekijänä työskentelet monipuolisesti Vaakunan tilaus- ja kokousravintolan tehtävissä, tukien sujuvia asiakastilaisuuksia. Työtehtäväsi voivat painottua joko keittiön puolen tehtäviin tai salin puolen tarjoilu- ja asiakaspalvelutehtäviin. Molemmissa tehtävissä työskennellään osana tiimiä.

Kokous- ja tilausravintolassamme järjestetään erilaisia asiakastilaisuuksia kuten illallisia, kokouksia ja juhlatilaisuuksia. Tarjoilut toteutetaan tilanteen mukaan buffet- tai pöytiintarjoiluna, ja kokonaisuuksiin kuuluu myös juomatarjoilu. Asiakastilaisuudet vaihtelevat pienistä ja tunnelmallisista kokouksista suuriin messuihin, juhliin ja jopa häihin, joten yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen.

Odotamme sinulta tinkimätöntä palveluasennetta, aktiivista työotetta sekä halua työskennellä tiiminä kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita ja onnistumisia. Aiempi kokemus ravintola-alalta tai asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi ja tehtävässä edellytetään täysi-ikäisyyttä. Tehtävään valitun tulisi pystyä työskentelemään kaikenlaisissa työvuoroissa ja olla valmis työskentelemään myös juhlapyhinä.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän upeassa hotelliympäristössä, jossa pääset luomaan mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia asiakkaillemme. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen sekä ympäristön, jossa laatu, vieraanvaraisuus ja yhdessä onnistuminen ovat keskiössä.

💚 Työntekijänämme saat käyttöösi S-ryhmän ja Satakunnan Osuuskaupan kattavat henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää täältä.

💰 Palkka määräytyy MaRaVa-alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti (13,70–15,04 €/h). Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus myös suoritepalkkioon.

Hakuaika päättyy su 13.9.2026.

Lisätietoja saat ravintolapäällikkö Pia Hirvelältä, pia.hirvela@sok.fi tai p. +358 44 725 1027.

Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on paikallinen yritys, jonka omistavat satakuntalaiset asiakasomistajat. Tehtävämme on tuottaa asiakasomistajillemme palveluita ja etuja. Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. Olemme osa valtakunnallista S-ryhmää.

jobs.title: Genopslag: Pædagog eller social-/sundhedsfaglig medarbejder søges til Snåstrup Vestergård
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye kollega?
Er du pædagog – nyuddannet eller erfaren? 
Eller har du en relevant social- eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse og den rette erfaring?
Har du samtidig lyst til et spændende og meningsfuldt arbejde med mennesker med udviklingshæmning, herunder borgere med dom?
Så er det måske lige dig, vi leder efter på Snåstrup Vestergård

Om Jobbet:
På Snåstrup Vestergaard – en del af Center for Specialpædagogik og Psykiatri (CSP) søger vi en socialpædagog eller pædagogisk assistent. 

Vi arbejder vi ud fra en grundlæggende tro på, at borgeren skal være ved roret i eget liv. Vores tilgang er recovery-orienteret rehabiliterende, og vi har et stærkt fokus på at understøtte borgernes håb, drømme og ønsker – både dem, der former hverdagen og dem, der rækker længere ud i livet. Det kræver en høj grad af faglighed, struktur og vedholdenhed, men også masser af nærvær, humor og varme i hverdagen.
Vi har pt plads til 20 borgere, som alle lever med et udviklingshandicap og har brug for denne særligt tilrettelagte pædagogiske indsats, er kriminalitetstruede eller idømte en foranstaltningsdom. Udviklingshandicappet er ofte kombineret med andre udfordringer som psykiatriske diagnoser og misbrugsproblematikker.

Din profil:
Som pædagog på Snåstrup bliver du en central del af et tværfagligt team med pædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter, ergoterapeut, sygeplejerske samt pædagogiske assistenter. Sammen med dine kollegaer får du ansvar for at tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere indsatser med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers behov, ressourcer og ønsker for livet.

I praksis betyder det, at du:

  • Støtter borgerne i deres dagligdag, fx omkring måltider, personlig omsorg, struktur og aktiviteter.
  • Planlægger og deltager i aktiviteter i dag- og fritidslivet, fx musik, madlavning, gåture, samt ledsagelse til behandlingstilbud som fx rusmiddelcenteret. 
  • Dokumenterer og evaluerer pædagogiske indsatser i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • Arbejder metodisk med afsæt i KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik) og neuropædagogisk tilgang. Desuden er vi i gang med implementering af LA2u, som du vil blive introduceret til. En metode til at inddrage borgerens indefra-perspektiv, forebygge voldsomme episoder og styrke trivsel, særligt tilpasset borgere med udviklingshæmning.
  • Indgår i samarbejdet om at skabe struktur, ro og tryghed, også i situationer, der kan være uforudsigelige eller præget af udadreagerende adfærd.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller har anden relevant socialfaglig eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse. 
  • Er nyuddannet og gerne vil have erfaring hos os eller kan have erfaring fra lignende område – gerne med borgere med udviklingshandicap og udfordrende adfærd - men det er ikke et krav.
  • Møder både borgere og kollegaer med respekt, ordentlighed og en anerkendende tilgang.
  • Kan bevare overblikket og handle konstruktivt i uforudsigelige situationer.
  • Trives i en hverdag, hvor opgaverne kan være mangeartede: fra praktiske gøremål til komplekse pædagogiske indsatser.
  • Har gyldigt kørekort og kan anvende IT til dokumentation.
  • Bidrager med stabilitet, engagement og et positivt sind - også når det går stærkt.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig:

Vi ønsker at skabe rammer, hvor både borgere og medarbejdere kan udvikle sig. Som ny pædagog på Snåstrup får du derfor:

  • Et grundigt introduktionsforløb med mentor og mulighed for introvagter efter behov.
  • Løbende faglig sparring, supervision og teammøder.
  • Mulighed for deltagelse i årlige temadage med fokus på faglig udvikling.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi tager arbejdsmiljøet alvorligt, og hvor der er plads til både faglige ambitioner, humor og fællesskab.

Kort sagt: Et job med faglige udfordringer, personlig udvikling og mulighed for at være en del af et sted, hvor indsatsen virkelig gør en forskel for andre mennesker.

Her kan du se lidt mere om Snåstrup: 

John D Band - SÆRTRANSPORT - official video 2021

Snåstrups Miljøteam maj 2024 - beboernes perspektiv

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.
Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest. Arbejdstiderne er dag og aftenvagter med et overtal af aftenvagter. Weekendarbejde hver anden weekend. 
Ugentligt timetal: Fuldtid.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til: Afdelingsleder Djanik Gade Laursen på 23807568 eller Line Julie Holck på 41876746

Ansøgning
Ansøgningsfrist er: søndag d. 6/9
Samtalerne afholdes torsdag d. 10/9

Opstart 1. november eller efter aftale. 
Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning.

Stillinger i Aarhus Kommune søges elektronisk. Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Om os
Centret samler bo- og aktivitetstilbud til borgere med udviklingshæmning, herunder personer med behov for en specialiseret indsats som følge af aldring, psykiatri, hjerneskade, dom, rusmiddelproblematikker eller et omfattende behov for pleje og omsorg. Indsatsen i centeret har fokus på at styrke borgernes forbundethed gennem relationer, almene fællesskaber og deltagelse i samfundslivet. Der arbejdes med at fremme borgerens tro på egne evner og bidrage til en selvforståelse der rækker udover funktionsnedsættelsen. Gennem hverdags- og arbejdsaktiviteter styrkes borgernes indflydelse på eget liv og evne til at mestre det. Centret har samlet fokus på at sikre en sammenhængende helhedsindsats på tværs af døgnet med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ressourcer, behov og muligheder.
  
Om Sociale Forhold og BeskæftigelseVi ved, at det gode liv går gennem uddannelse, job og selvforsørgelse for langt de fleste – og meningsfulde fællesskaber for alle. Derfor er vi mere end 7000 mennesker, der går på arbejde hver dag for aarhusianere med et handicap, et integrationsbehov, dem, der lever socialt udsatte liv og dem, der har brug for at finde vej til det næste job. Vi arbejder med alt det, der er svært, men også med det vigtigste, der findes: aarhusianernes kernevelfærd. Vi er årligt i kontakt med omkring 100.000 aarhusianere, der får vores støtte til et liv med håb og handlekraft.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.    

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

jobs.title: Barcelona Winbacksäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av rörliga elavtal till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Ravintolatyöntekijäksi kokouspalvelun tehtäviin Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORI

Ravintolatyöntekijäksi kokouspalvelun tehtäviin Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan

Tule vastaamaan asiakkaidemme sujuvista ja viimeistellyistä tilaus- ja kokoustapahtumista! Haemme Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan kokous- ja tilausravintolaan kahta ravintolatyöntekijää työskentelemään kokouspalvelun tehtävissä. Tehtävät ovat osa-aikaisia, 20 h/vko ja määräaikaisia vuoden 2026 loppuun, aloitus on joustavasti sovittavissa. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme niin arkena kuin myös juhlapyhinä, joten työvuorot voivat sijoittua koko viikon akselille ja kyseessä on vaihteleva vuorotyö.

Tule kanssamme tekemään ihan tavallisia töitä ja luomaan elämyksiä, jotka jäävät asiakkaidemme mieleen!

Työ on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu kokouspalveluiden toteuttaminen aina kokoustilojen valmistelusta ja asiakkaiden toiveiden huomioimisesta kahvitarjoiluiden esillelaittoon ja lounastarjoiluun. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan erilaisten tilaisuuksien ja illallisten järjestämiseen kokous- ja tilausravintolassamme. Tarjoilut toteutetaan tilanteen mukaan buffet- tai pöytiintarjoiluna, ja kokonaisuuksiin kuuluu myös juomatarjoilu. Asiakastilaisuudet vaihtelevat pienistä ja tunnelmallisista kokouksista suuriin messuihin, juhliin ja jopa häihin, joten yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen.

Meille kaikkein tärkeintä on aito huomaavaisuus ja asiakkaidemme odotusten ylittäminen. Odotamme sinulta tinkimätöntä palveluasennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä halua työskennellä tiiminä kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita ja onnistumisia. Haluat ottaa vastuuta onnistuneista asiakaskohtaamisista ja varmistaa vieraidemme viihtyvyyden kokous toisensa jälkeen. Aiempi kokemus ravintola-alalta tai asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi. Tehtävässä edellytetään täysi-ikäisyyttä.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän upeassa hotelliympäristössä, jossa pääset luomaan mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia asiakkaillemme. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen sekä ympäristön, jossa laatu, vieraanvaraisuus ja yhdessä onnistuminen ovat keskiössä.

💰 Palkka määräytyy MaRaVa-alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti (13,70–15,04 €/h). Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus myös suoritepalkkioon.

Hakuaika päättyy su 13.9.2026.

Lisätietoja saat ravintolapäällikkö Pia Hirvelältä, pia.hirvela@sok.fi tai p. +358 44 725 1027.

Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. Efter grundig kort oplæring af vores koncept, skal du udføre prøve- og instruktørtimer til nye og nuværende medlemmer ved guidning og fysisk instruktion.

Du skal på brugerniveau kunne benytte vores eget IT-system til at oprette nye medlemmer, oprette aftaler mm. Du skal kunne tale og skrive dansk, da du både er i personlig kontakt, telefonisk kontakt og skrivende kontakt med medlemmer og kollegaer.

Du skal være smilende, serviceminded og empatisk og du skal kunne kommunikere med kunder i alle aldre

Du skal fysisk kunne deltage i rengøringsopgaver i centret, da vi sætter stor pris på at vores center altid er pænt og rent, men opgaverne er tilpasset og opdelt.

Du skal kunne træne i vores udstyr og hvis man har lyst, er der mulighed for at kunne undervise i holdtræning.

Du skal selvstændigt kunne arbejde på vagter af 4-6 timers varighed ad gangen hvor man aktivt skal være i centret i hele vagten, gående og stående med afveksling. Vagterne kan ligge i både formiddags- og eftermiddagstimerne, samt i weekender.

Der vil til tider være arrangementer, events og outgoing opgaver.

Vi forventer at du er god til at skabe kontakt til andre mennesker, er ansvarsbevidst, selvkørende, smilende og udadvendt. At du kan få alle vores medlemmer til at føle sig velkommen, hver gang de kommer og træner.

Hvad kan du forvente af os:

I LOOP er vi kendt for vores gode service og nærvær og vores arrangement sammen med vores medlemmer, så du vil blive en del af et godt team, der hjælper hinanden og du vil få en arbejdsplads med skønne sociale medlemmer omkring dig.

Hos os kan du forvente et arbejde med frihed under ansvar, du vil blive grundigt oplært i den daglige drift, og der vil løbende være kurser der oplære dig i korrekt brug af maskinerne mm.

Lyder det som jobbet for dig, så send en mail til Tanja på tjm@loopfitness.dk

Der vil løbende blive indkaldt til samtaler, med opstart snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Area Chief Engineer, Oslo
jobs.description:
Company Description

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time.

Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description

We are currently seeking an Area Chief Engineer to join our vibrant team. At RHG, we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences. We value mindset as pivotal: anticipating guest needs, supporting your department, and consistently delivering memorable experiences.

The Area Chief Engineer role offers the opportunity to shape and lead the engineering strategy across our hotels in the Oslo area. The role is responsible for leading and overseeing the engineering, security and technical operations.

In addition to being a hands-on position, this role focuses on leadership, project management, asset optimisation and supporting our hotel engineering teams to deliver operational excellence.

Working across our Oslo portfolio, you will oversee engineering operations, major maintenance projects, CapEx investments, technical compliance and security coordination while acting as a trusted advisor to hotel leadership, property owners and external partners.

If you are an organised engineering leader who enjoys bringing structure, driving improvements and leading complex technical projects, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and support the Chief Engineers across the Oslo area hotel portfolio, creating consistency, structure and best practice.
  • Oversee engineering operations across our hotels in the Oslo area, ensuring maintenance, safety and technical standards are delivered to the highest level.
  • Plan, manage and oversee major refurbishment, renovation and technical installation projects from budgeting through execution.
  • Manage CapEx projects, long-term investment plans and engineering budgets, ensuring cost-effective delivery and value for owners.
  • Support hotel engineering teams with procurement, investment applications, project planning and technical administration.
  • Act as the technical liaison between Radisson Hotel Group, property owners, contractors and external suppliers.
  • Ensure effective preventive maintenance programmes are planned, monitored and continuously improved.
  • Coordinate engineering strategies that maximise asset performance, minimise downtime and improve operational efficiency.
  • Oversee engineering-related sustainability initiatives, including energy-saving projects and optimisation of building systems.
  • Work closely with the dedicated security team to ensure fire safety, emergency procedures, compliance inspections and technical safety programmes are effectively coordinated across all properties.
  • Ensure all engineering activities comply with legislation, health & safety requirements, fire regulations and Radisson Hotel Group standards.
  • Build strong relationships with General Managers and hotel leadership teams, providing expert technical guidance and support.
Qualifications

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent leadership and organisational skills.

You will ideally have:

  • An engineering qualification or degree, preferably within mechanical, electrical, building services or technical installations.
  • Extensive experience leading engineering, maintenance or technical operations across multiple sites or complex properties.
  • Experience managing large technical projects, renovations, CapEx investments and contractor relationships.
  • Strong understanding of property maintenance, building systems and technical installations.
  • Excellent financial and commercial awareness, including budgeting and investment planning.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to coach, influence and develop teams.
  • Outstanding planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work with hotel leaders, owners, contractors and suppliers.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
  • Fluency in Norwegian and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.description:
Erfaren tjener søges til Michelin-anbefalede Restaurant Abigail i indre by - deltid

Brænder du for klassisk værtskab, stor faglighed og den personlige gæsteoplevelse? Har du øje for detaljen, arbejder struktureret – og elsker du at levere service på højeste niveau? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Restaurant Abigail leverer gastronomi på absolut højeste niveau. Her kan du opleve en eksklusiv 11-retters tastingmenu, hvor hver servering er nøje komponeret med fokus på smag, æstetik og kvalitet. Dertil byder restauranten på et imponerende stort og bredt vinkort med udsøgte vine fra hele verden – nøje udvalgt til at fuldende din oplevelse.

Til vores dedikerede team søger vi nu en erfaren tjener med vinkendskab, der vil være med til at løfte vores gæsteoplevelser endnu højere.

Om stillingen

  • Deltid med fleksibel vagtplan

  • Start: Efter aftale – vi venter gerne på den rette

  • Arbejdssted: København

  • Løn: Konkurrencedygtig og baseret på erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har minimum 1 års erfaring som tjener – gerne fra gastronomisk niveau

  • Er fagligt stærk, detaljeorienteret og vant til at arbejde struktureret

  • Brænder for vin og mad i samspil

  • Trives i et travlt miljø med høje standarder og naturlig gæstekontakt

  • Er en god kollega og teamplayer med positiv energi og ansvarsfølelse

Vi tilbyder:

  • En vigtig rolle i et lille, dedikeret team med stærkt sammenhold

  • Mulighed for videreudvikling, f.eks. som ansvarlig på gulvet, med menu- og vinkort-præsentationer og eventuelt ansvar for oplæring af nye kollegaer

  • En flad organisation med respekt og plads til den enkelte

  • En arbejdsplads hvor arbejdsglæde og faglighed går hånd i hånd

  • Gode personalegoder – bl.a. fordelagtige priser på vores restauranter

Hvorfor vælge os?

Hos Abigail prioriterer vi kvalitet – både i forhold til vores produkt og i vores arbejdsmiljø. Vi tror på, at den bedste service kommer fra et sted med overskud og arbejdsglæde. Du bliver en del af en restaurant, hvor både gæster og medarbejdere føler sig hjemme, og hvor den gode stemning mærkes fra første møde.

Er du klar til næste skridt i din tjenerkarriere – i et miljø med hjerte, faglighed og ambitioner?
