jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper med flair for administration og struktur
jobs.description:
Er du studerende og har du interesse for administration og struktur? Så søger team Optag, Planlægning og Prøver en kompetentstudentermedhjælper 10-15 timer om ugen.

Team Optag, Planlægning og Prøver varetager mange forskellige opgaver inden for optag, skemaplanlægning og prøveafvikling. Du skal understøtte vores team med opgaver inden for planlægning.

Absalon er en af landets seks professionshøjskoler og dækker geografisk Region Sjælland. Vi har et stærkt fokus på undervisning af høj kvalitet, studieengagement og regional forankring. Vi har uddannelser i syv byer, efter- og videreuddannelser i vækst og en stærk udvikling inden for anvendelsesorienteret forskning i samarbejde med praksis.

Din profil
Som studentermedhjælper i Uddannelsesservice vil du blive en vigtig administrativ medspiller i teamet. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med administrativt arbejde, og det er vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Godt overblik og sans for detaljen. Du er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og arbejder systematisk. Du trives med at arbejde dig igennem sagsbunker og gør det med stor kvalitet, men du har også øje for detaljerne i de enkelte sager.

Du har mod på at sætte dig ind i procedurer og rammer. Det ligger dig naturligt at arbejde ud fra grundige vejledninger og organisatoriske rammer.

God til at kommunikere skriftligt og mundtligt. Du kan i tale og skrift forklare procedurer og rammer på en let forståelig måde. Du kan være forstående og hjælpsom uden at gå på kompromis med de rammer og regler, som er gældende.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • er aktiv studerende på en videregående uddannelse.
  • har kendskab til Microsoft 365.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som studentermedhjælper i Team Optag, Planlægning og Prøver skal du understøtte teamets skemaplanlæggere og bidrage til, at studerende og undervisere får velfungerende skemaer. Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:

Understøtte skemaplanlægningen. Du hjælper skemaplanlæggerne med at klargøre og kvalitetssikre det grundlag, der bruges til skemalægningen. Det kan fx være kontrol af oplysninger om hold, undervisere, aktiviteter og lokaler samt opfølgning på manglende eller uklare oplysninger.

Understøtte lokaleplanlægningen. Du hjælper med at skabe overblik over brugen af undervisningslokaler og undersøger muligheder for alternative lokaler, når der opstår behov for ændringer. Du kan også bidrage med kontrol af, om lokaler matcher aktiviteternes størrelse og behov.

Besvare henvendelser om skemaer. Du hjælper med at besvare og følge op på henvendelser om skemaer via vores fælles platform Podio. Det kan fx være spørgsmål fra undervisere og uddannelser om skemaer, lokaler og ændringer. Du håndterer de henvendelser, der kan besvares ud fra gældende retningslinjer og praksis, og sørger for, at øvrige spørgsmål kommer videre til den rette skemaplanlægger.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af et nyt team, hvor optag, planlægning og prøver er samlet i ét fælles fagligt miljø. Vi er 21 kolleger med forskellige kompetencer og erfaringer, som arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe gode løsninger for studerende, undervisere og uddannelser.

Vi prioriterer sparring, videndeling og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og udvikler vores opgaver sammen.

Teamet er en del af Uddannelsesservice med i alt omkring 90 medarbejdere, der understøtter hele Absalons uddannelsesadministration. Du får arbejdssted på Campus Slagelse, der ligger lige på trinbrættet til stationen.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på deltid med 10-15 timer om ugen, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder snarest muligt.
  • Timelønnen for studentermedhjælpere ligger på 145,91 kr. ex. pension. Pensionsbidraget er på 16%.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte teamleder, Claus Gerstrøm Eliasen, tlf. 7248 1823.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest mandag den 7. september 2026.
  • Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

jobs.title: Medarbetare till Haraldsbyfabrikens Logistikavdelning
jobs.description:
**Vill du bli en del av ett engagerat team i livsmedelsindustrin?**

Vi söker nu en noggrann och ansvarstagande medarbetare till vår ompacksavdelning.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en viktig del av produktionen där kvalitet, effektivitet och samarbete står i fokus.

**Om tjänsten**

Som medarbetare på ompacksavdelningen arbetar du med ompacketering av specialorders från kund, sortering, och agerar även ibland stöd åt vår produktionsavdelning.

Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med kollegor från både produktion och lager.

Tjänsten innefattar även lättare lyft och fysiskt arbete, vilket gör att du trivs med att vara i rörelse under arbetsdagen.

Denna tjänst innebär skiftesarbete

**Vi söker dig som**

- Har god samarbetsförmåga och en positiv inställning

- Trivs med praktiskt arbete

- Är ansvarstagande och flexibel

- Kan följa instruktioner och rutiner inom livsmedelssäkerhet och kvalitet


Tidigare erfarenhet från produktion, lager eller livsmedelsindustri är meriterande, men inget krav.

**Vi erbjuder**

- En trygg arbetsplats med trevliga kollegor

- Introduktion och upplärning på plats i verksamheten

- Möjlighet att utvecklas inom verksamheten

- Ett arbete där du bidrar till att leverera produkter av hög kvalitet till våra kunder


**Låter detta intressant?**

Tjänsten är tidsbestämd fram till och med 23.12.2026 med viss möjlighet till förlängning

Närmare uppgifter om tjänsten ger vår Logistikchef Stefan Nyman på telefon 040 743 7234 Vi behandlar ansökningarna i den takt de kommer in, så lämna in din ansökan redan idag till job.ocs@orkla.fi, **sista ansökningsdag är 11:e september**

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Himmerlandskød søger mester til nathold i Farsø
jobs.description:
Himmerlandskød er en dansk, familieejet fødevarevirksomhed med eget slagteri, opskæring og forædling af dansk okse- og kalvekød i Himmerland.

Fordelt på to lokationer i Himmerland, i henholdsvis Aalestrup og Farsø, beskæftiger vi +250 medarbejdere.

I Farsø udbener og videreforarbejder vi det kød, der er slagtet på vores eget slagteri i Aalestrup, og her søger vi lige nu en engageret og ansvarlig mester til natholdet.

Der er tale om en fast stilling med en 5-dages arbejdsuge fra søndag til torsdag nat. Som arbejdende mester får du ansvaret for planlægning og produktion af ugens opgaver på to hakkekøds- og detaillinjer, mens virksomheden samtidig udvider med nye linjer, som du får mulighed for at præge fra starten.

Du bliver en del af en ny produktion med topmoderne udstyr, som giver dig en unik mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling – og for at sætte dit præg på din egen arbejdsplads i tæt samarbejde med et team på 10-12 medarbejdere.

Som vores nye mester ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med kød og forarbejdning heraf
  • Har forståelse for produktion og er praktisk anlagt
  • Har flair for ledelse og kan træffe beslutninger
  • Har et godt humør og en positiv tilgang til både opgaver og kolleger

Hvis du kan se dig selv i ovenstående stilling og har lyst til at sikre dig en fremtid i en spændende virksomhed, så send dine oplysninger til job@himmerlandskoed.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte produktionschef Robert Svanholm på tlf. 21 68 79 50.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, men venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Opbevaring af din ansøgning:

I forbindelse med at du søger job hos Himmerlandskød, registreres din ansøgning og dine data. Din ansøgning bliver brugt til at vurdere, om vi nu eller på et senere tidspunkt kan tilbyde dig et job. Dine personlige oplysninger bliver naturligvis behandlet fortroligt. Vi sletter dine personoplysninger, når ansøgningsrunden er afsluttet (efter maks. 6 måneder).

jobs.title: Raskaan kaluston mekaanikko
jobs.description:
Haluatko työskennellä Euroopan markkinajohtajan parissa kuljetusalan leasing- ja huoltopalveluissa? TIP Group tarjoaa ratkaisuja kuorma-autoille, perävaunuille ja muille kuljetusvälineille. Autamme asiakkaitamme pitämään kalustonsa liikkeessä tarjoamalla joustavia leasing-, vuokraus- ja huoltoratkaisuja eri puolilla Eurooppaa.



Olemme laajentamassa Lieton korjaamotoimintaamme perävaunuista myös kuorma-autojen huoltoon ja korjaukseen. Tästä syystä etsimme kokenutta raskaan kaluston mekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tässä roolissa toimit Lieton toimipisteen ensisijaisena kuorma-automekaanikkona. Työ edellyttää vahvaa ammattitaitoa, kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä halua ottaa vastuuta päivittäisestä tekemisestä.

Jos sinulla on kokemusta kuorma-autojen huolloista ja korjauksista sekä haluat työskennellä osaavassa ja mutkattomassa työyhteisössä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.



Tehtäväsi

Työssäsi vastaat pääsääntöisesti kuorma-autojen sekä tarvittaessa myös perävaunujen ja muun raskaan kaluston huolloista, korjauksista ja tarkastuksista, kuten:

Tarkastukset ja määräaikaishuollot
Vianmääritys ja korjaustyöt
Kaluston turvallisuuden, käyttövarmuuden ja liikennekelpoisuuden varmistaminen
Yhteistyö asiakkaiden sekä oman tiimin kanssa



Mitä tuot mukanasi

Vahvaa kokemusta erityisesti kuorma-autojen huolloista, korjauksista ja vikadiagnostiikasta
Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ottaa vastuuta päivittäisestä tekemisestä
Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
Kykyä työskennellä myös kiireisissä tilanteissa huolellisuudesta tinkimättä
Positiivista asennetta ja hyvää huumorintajua

Eduksi katsomme C-ajokortin sekä kokemuksen perävaunutekniikasta, jarrujärjestelmistä sekä sähkö- ja hydrauliikkajärjestelmistä.


Miksi TIP?

Meillä pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ja vakaassa yrityksessä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja ammattitaidon kehittämiseen panostetaan. Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työnkuvan, nykyaikaisen työympäristön sekä ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen. Osaamisen kehittämistä tuemme koulutusten ja käytännön työn kautta.

Vaikka kuorma-autojen huoltotoiminta on Lietossa uutta, työskentelet osana kokenutta korjaamotiimiä, jossa arvostetaan yhteistyötä, osaamisen jakamista ja yhdessä onnistumista. Arjessamme yhdistyvät vahva ammattitaito ja hyvä tekemisen meininki.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til rengøringsteam SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til vores rengørings-team på Fyn.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.09.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.title: Inspector, Private Home Cleaning  - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for a dedicated inspector for our private home cleaning department

Do you have an eye for detail, and do you thrive in a role where quality and great customer relations go hand in hand? Then you might be our new inspector.

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024. We provide cleaning for housing associations, businesses and private customers across Greater Copenhagen – and it is our private customers you will be working with.

About the job

As inspector in our private cleaning department, you will be the link between our customers and our cleaning teams. You will report to the company's owner and managing director and play a central role in making sure quality is spot on every single time.

Your main tasks will be:

•      Quality control – ongoing inspection of completed cleaning in our private customers' homes

•      Quality reports – documentation and follow-up on inspection visits

•      Customer contact and relations – dialogue with customers, handling requests and feedback, and building long-term customer relationships

•      Operational support – hands-on support for the daily operations of the private cleaning department

Other tasks within the scope and responsibility of the position may also occur.

We expect that you

•      Have experience from the cleaning industry, the service industry or a similar role with quality responsibility

•      Have a sharp eye for detail and high standards for quality

•      Are outgoing and service-minded and enjoy daily customer contact

•      Communicate confidently in Danish, both spoken and written, including for reporting

•      Work in a structured and independent way and can plan your own day

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as the working day involves driving between customers

Experience with quality control or inspection work is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We offer

•      A full-time position of 40 hours per week with a fixed monthly salary

•      Employment as a salaried employee (funktionær) under proper terms – any overtime is compensated with time off in lieu at a 1:1 ratio

•      Health insurance paid by the company

•      A company car for work use by agreement, and work clothing where the position requires it

•      An informal and busy working day in a growing company with short decision-making paths

•      Green values in practice: Nordic Swan Ecolabel certification and an electric vehicle fleet

Practical information

•      Workplace: Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup – with daily driving to customers across Greater Copenhagen

•      Working hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday between 8:00 and 17:00 (Friday until 16:30)

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

jobs.title: Customer Success - Support & Training Specialist
jobs.employer: BTR Personnel services AB, filial af BTR Personnel services AB, Sverige
jobs.description:
Position Overview: We are seeking a full-time Support & Training Specialist based in Copenhagen, Denmark. In this role, you will provide front-line technical assistance, software guidance, and application training to users of our clinical trial technology platform. Your primary responsibilities will focus on resolving user software inquiries, handling application data change requests, creating end-user documentation, and guiding platform onboarding. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to technical troubleshooting.

We are looking for candidates who are detail-oriented, responsive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Ideal candidates will demonstrate a passion for customer service, the ability to execute tasks with precision, and excellent communication and documentation skills.

What You’ll Do:

● User Application Support: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for software users across Europe and globally, diagnosing and resolving application usage questions via ticket or email.

● System & Data Management: Process application data change requests with accuracy, verifying data integrity within the platform.

● User Onboarding & Training: Conduct virtual application walkthroughs and training sessions to ensure platform users understand system functionality and protocol-specific workflows.

● Technical Documentation: Create, update, and maintain user-facing help guides, application FAQs, training manuals, and application release notes.

● Incident Logging & Escalation: Track, document, and reproduce technical software issues reported by users, escalating system bugs to internal engineering teams when necessary.

● Quality Assurance: Verify system functionality post-updates and contribute to feedback loops for software usability improvements.

 

 What You’ll Need:

● Strong interest in user support, software training, or technical help desk functions.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain software features clearly to non-technical users.

● High attention to detail and strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

● Ability to manage incoming support tickets effectively in a fast-paced environment.

● Experience creating software documentation, user guides, or training materials.

● Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s  Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.  https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role:

Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.



You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

 - Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

 - Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.

 - Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams.

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

 - Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform.



Required skills and experience:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software

 - Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments

 - Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals.

 - Experience designing and owning complex technical systems from architecture through production

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive technical projects to completion

 - Strong technical communication skills and experience working directly with customers, partners, or cross-functional stakeholders

 - Ability to translate business requirements and customer problems into pragmatic technical solutions



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, consulting, or another highly technical customer-facing role

 - Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, or developer tools

 - Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, application deployment, databases, APIs, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns

 - Experience integrating software into complex enterprise environments, including identity and access management, internal data sources, APIs, and existing developer infrastructure

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead the systems, data, and process work behind how we bill, recognize revenue, close the books, and prove our controls work.



You won't be writing the code or drawing the architecture; you'll be deciding what gets built, in what order, and why it matters. This is a role for someone who wants to understand a business well enough to change how it runs: learning the objectives, processes, and system flows end to end, then shaping them into strategic technical programs with real owners, deliberate sequencing, and decisions that hold up under audit. You'll sit between Finance and Accounting on one side and Engineering, Data, and Product on the other, and you'll be accountable for making new revenue streams operable and auditable, from a pricing model on a slide to a billed invoice, a booked journal entry, and a control that passes testing.



You'll report to the Lead Technical Program Manager for Data, Biztech & AI Transformation, within EPD. You'll get high-level direction and clear priorities from your manager, and independent ownership of how the work actually gets delivered. You'll bring engineering-side rigor and platform thinking to finance problems, and work as part of a team modernizing how the whole company operates.



Most of your time will go to three things: making new product and pricing launches work end to end in the finance stack, running the platforms and data flows behind quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and driving the IT general controls (ITGC) program so controls are designed into systems up front rather than retrofitted after go-live.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Act as Finance's technical counterpart on new product, pricing, and packaging launches, translating commercial models into requirements across order capture, rating and billing, tax, revenue recognition, and downstream reporting, and defining what "revenue-ready" means before go/no-go: who owns each piece, what's actually done versus asserted, and which risks are still cheap to fix

 - Broker the trade-off when a launch date and systems reality don't line up: a scoped manual workaround with an owner, a cost, and an expiration date, plus the path to the automated version. Then close the loop after launch on billing accuracy, exception rates, where revenue landed, whether the new controls actually operate, and what must be true to do this again at 10x volume

 - Independently own delivery and multi-quarter roadmaps for your finance systems programs, including ERP, billing and subscription management, CPQ, revenue subledger, procurement, and the reporting layer on top. Run the working groups that deliver them across Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Data, and Security, with clear accountability and updates leadership can read in two minutes

 - Run the operating rhythm: intake and prioritization, decision logs, early risk escalation, and a small set of metrics that show whether the work is actually improving anything, and flag early when committed scope and capacity don't line up

 - Map current-state processes and data lineage end to end and go after the breaks: reconciliation gaps, recurring manual journal entries, spreadsheets doing load-bearing work, competing sources of truth for the same metric. Partner with Data Engineering on the definitions and data contracts that let finance metrics tie cleanly to source systems, and hold the line when teams drift

 - Drive ITGC workstreams across in-scope financial systems: logical access and segregation of duties, change management, SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, job scheduling, and data interfaces. Partner with Internal Audit on scoping and control design, with a named owner for every control

 - Facilitate designing controls into new systems, systems changes, and launches before go-live with Controllership, Internal Audit, and Engineering, and serve as the systems-side point of contact for internal and external audit on ITGC walkthroughs and testing, translating between control language and engineering language, and driving deficiencies through root cause, named owners, evidence, and validation that the fix holds

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that expand what the teams around you can cover, and hold them to real standards: a defined task, a way to evaluate output quality, explicit human review gates on anything touching financial reporting, and documentation so someone else can run it




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 -  5+ years in technical program management, business systems, finance transformation, or a related field, with substantial time on finance or revenue systems; public-company or IPO-track experience is a strong plus

 - Working fluency in finance operations; you don't need to be an accountant, but you should hold your own on quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and know why revenue recognition is not the same as billing

 - Hands-on ITGC program experience across access, change management, and IT operations for in-scope financial systems, plus practical SOX knowledge. You understand how ITGC reliance determines what auditors will accept from automated controls and system-generated reports, can tell a key control from a non-key one, know where ITACs fit alongside ITGCs, and have been through remediation and audit cycles rather than only reading about them

 - AI-native operating mindset; this is a core requirement for this role. You already use AI to draft requirements, synthesize status, triage intake, and assemble evidence packages, and you share the patterns so others work differently because of what you built

 - A track record of independently delivering technical programs end to end, ideally transformation work such as system modernization, a large-scale migration, or an ERP or billing platform implementation, and turning messy or incomplete inputs into a concrete plan with owners and dates; you're pulled into problems before they're scoped and you're as useful advising a controller on process design as an engineering lead on sequencing

 - Working understanding of data lifecycle and analytics tooling, and real experience running change management for business systems, not just launching them

 - Influence without authority and a bias toward closure. You have no direct reports, so you work through credibility and clear reasoning, knowing when to push and when to escalate; you chase ambiguous items to a decision, will reopen the uncomfortable question a week before launch, and communicate clearly with Director/VP+ stakeholders, including when the news is bad




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Hands-on experience working in enterprise billing, ERP, and revenue systems such as NetSuite, Stripe, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how orders, invoices, and revenue data flow between them

 - Experience supporting an IPO readiness or first-year SOX program, including standing up ITGCs from scratch

 - CISA, CIA, or equivalent certification, or equivalent time embedded on an IT audit team

 - Experience building internal tooling or agents on a workspace platform rather than only configuring vendor systems

jobs.title: Director of Compensation Strategy
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE SUMMARY

Replit is the world's most widely used AI coding platform, and as we scale, we're rebuilding how compensation works internally from the ground up. This role owns that. You'll go beyond traditional comp management to architect the systems, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled workflows that make fast, consistent, and high-quality compensation decisions possible at scale. 

You will serve as the architect of our compensation engine: translating compensation philosophy into scalable systems, and utilizing AI to improve speed, accuracy, and transparency. 

You will partner closely with People Business Partners, Recruiting, Finance, People Operations, and the Data team to embed compensation directly into company workflows, eliminating manual processes and reducing reliance on comp as a service layer.

You will shape how we attract, reward, and retain top talent, while building infrastructure that scales with the business.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Compensation Strategy

 - Evolve our compensation philosophy across cash and equity; design and maintain salary bands, leveling frameworks, and equity structures

 - Ensure market competitiveness while partnering with Finance on cost and workforce planning

 - Operate compensation planning cycles and generate first-pass recommendations for comp decisions

 - Build dashboards and analytical frameworks covering market competitiveness, internal equity, retention risk, and workforce cost



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in compensation, total rewards, or related analytical roles, ideally at a high-growth tech company

 - Deep expertise in salary bands, equity design, and market benchmarking (broad-based, sales, and executive)

 - Strong systems thinker who can translate policy into scalable workflows and decision logic

 - Product mindset - you think in terms of users, workflows, and iteration

 - High ownership; willing to operate hands-on


Nice to have

AI-Native Workflows

 - Design and implement AI-enabled workflows for offers, merit, promotions, and market adjustments

 - Build human-in-the-loop validation frameworks to audit AI-generated recommendations for bias, accuracy, and logic
   
   
   Tools: Pave, Radford, Rippling, Lattice, Ashby, Carta, Google Sheets, internal AI/automation tooling

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Part time (0.25 - 0.75)

jobs.title: Job i udlandet - Dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejder til onlinecasino på Malta
jobs.description:
Vi søger en dygtig kundeservicemedarbejder til vores kontor i Gzira, Malta med opstart hurtigst muligt. Din primære opgave bliver at besvare indkomne skriftlige henvendelser fra vores kunder via e-mail og chat. Vores mål er at sikre, at alle kunder modtager professionel vejledning og den bedst mulige service. Som kundeservicemedarbejder er service din vigtigste opgave. Du skal have lyst til at formulere dig skriftligt, være løsningsorienteret og brænde for at yde en fremragende kundeoplevelse. Ingen opgave er for stor eller for lille, når det handler om at hjælpe vores kunder.

Dine opgaver:

  • Besvare kundeforespørgsler via e-mail og chat.

  • Sikre, at komplekse kundehenvendelser bliver løst hurtigt og tilfredsstillende.

  • Yde teknisk support og vejledning om spil.

  • Overvåge hjemmesidens tilgængelighed og funktionalitet samt rapportere fejl og problemer.

  • Deltage i test af nye produkter og tjenester.

  • Medvirke til at promovere nye produkter og kampagner.

  • Bidrage til andre arbejdsopgaver i virksomheden efter behov.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er serviceorienteret, udadvendt, hjælpsom og imødekommende.

  • Har fremragende skriftlige danskkundskaber og gode engelskkundskaber.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at nå interne mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer.

  • Har erfaring med digitale arbejdsopgaver – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.

 - Fluent in English and French






NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av tv-abonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Gitlab Delivery: Upgrades
Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricated tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department: The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the transport and immersion of the elements.

To float, move and immerse the Tunnel Elements, temporary installations are required. A team of mechanics, riggers and electricians installs and tests these systems. The Commissioning Engineer analyzes technical input to optimize performance and plan ahead, working closely with technical staff and operations.

Main tasks and responsibilities: The Site Engineer Automation ensures operational readiness of the temporary systems in the tunnel elements and continuously improves them based on operational feedback to optimize installation efficiency.

  • Creates and follows a testing protocol for all installations.

  • Leads the commissioning of the standard and special tunnel elements.

  • Adapts system changes according to new insights.

  • Provides correct reports and documentation to the site engineers.

jobs.title: Residential Technician
jobs.description:
Celebrate Life, the Southworth Way

The Company: Welcome to Southworth. We own and operate a growing portfolio of premier private communities, each offering inspired environments and locations. Our dedication to hospitality and endless activities for the entire family ensures our members experience a world at play like never before.

With a solid reputation for stability, integrity, and innovation, Southworth's clubs and communities provide exceptional locations where our members can truly live life at ease. Our dedicated team members play a crucial role in elevating the experience for our members, residents, guests, and fellow team members. We encourage all our team members to be and belong by providing a wide array of benefits, engagement programs, unique perks, discounts, and, of course, a lot of fun!

The Benefits: We are proud of our âfamily companyâ roots and understand everyone has a unique set of needs: we want to support you as best we can so you can live your best life with us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive options for medical, physical, and mental health and wellness, life insurance, 401k matching, paid time off, and more.

Grow with us! The sky is the limit for talented, driven individuals. With our ever-expanding portfolio, we offer opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. We look forward to growing together.

Be YOU with us! At Southworth, we are working to redefine the country club. We seek talent from a diverse range of backgrounds, experiences, and cultures to ensure an innovative edge. Here, diversity is a driver of our success.

About The Abaco Club: The Abaco Club is a paradise for the soul. It is an unassuming haven crafted in the pursuit of connection, happiness and belonging. Here, members unwind in barefoot luxury in island-inspired homes, golfers take on the #1 golf course in The Bahamas, and generations come together on 2 miles of uninterrupted white sands on one of the most pristine beaches on Earth.

Working at The Abaco Club means being part of a vibrant community that values your knowledge and offers opportunities for professional growth and development. Here, you can turn your passion for hospitality into a rewarding career while enjoying the stunning scenery of this beautiful place. Become a part of our team and help us show what makes the Abaco Club truly extraordinary.

The Opportunity: The Residential Technician is responsible for performing preventive interior and exterior home maintenance, including monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, and annual services and inspections as assigned by the Homeowner Services Manager. This role ensures homes and Club facilities are maintained to the highest standards, working closely with Homeowners Representatives, Housekeeping, Front Desk, and Reservations. The technician will complete punch-list items, identify deficiencies, and follow through to resolution to preserve the Homeownersâ assets.

Duties And Functions

  • Coordinate with the Homeowner Services Manager and Assistant Manager on all home-related issues, ensuring timely follow-up with relevant departments.
  • Assist with the installation and setup of new homes as needed.
  • Inspect homes at least five days prior to member and guest arrivals to confirm they meet Club and Owner Standards; resolve maintenance issues promptly. Pre-arrival checks include: air filters, shower heads, bathroom hardware, kitchen appliances, HVAC functionality, light fixtures, bulbs, fans, internet/TV services, septic systems, door locks, propane levels, plumbing, grills, and any reported issues.
  • Conduct monthly, quarterly, and annual maintenance services per the Management program.
  • Record all services and inspections using the designated app, including work performed, materials used, and time allocated.
  • Inspect and maintain all aspects of the homeâs interior and exterior, including pools and pool equipment.
  • Assist with golf cart and vehicle maintenance/cleaning as assigned.
  • Support maintenance of Club outlets and facilities as directed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Qualification Standards
